name: WhatsApp
description: Enables interaction with customers through the WhatsApp Business API for messaging and automation. Only supports WhatsApp Business accounts, not WhatsApp Personal accounts.

tools.name: Accept business solution
tools.description: Accept an invitation for the authenticated partner app to join a Multi-Partner Solution. Requires an eligible Solution Partner, Tech Provider, or Tech Partner and an invited app; the solution must be INITIATED. Review the solution's name and owner/partner permissions before acceptance: accepted solutions cannot then be declined. Acceptance changes partner status to ACCEPTED and may activate the solution once all required partners accept. If the app will access onboarded client data, Meta additionally requires App Review approval for both whatsapp_business_management and whatsapp_business_messaging.

inputs.name: solution_id
inputs.about: Multi-Partner Solution ID from the invitation, partner_solutions webhook's solution_id, or Partner solutions panel in the Meta App Dashboard.

inputs.name: log_session_id
inputs.about: Optional logging/debugging session identifier to track the acceptance flow across API calls.

inputs.name: partner_app_id
inputs.about: Meta app ID of the invited partner accepting the solution. Must match the app that received the invitation; find it in the Meta App Dashboard.

tools.name: Accept solution deactivation
tools.description: Accept a pending Multi-Partner Solution deactivation request. Completes the partner approval workflow: ACTIVE/PENDING_DEACTIVATION becomes DEACTIVATED/NONE. The solution can no longer onboard clients through Embedded Signup. Requires an eligible partner setup and authorization for the solution; the multi-partner guide specifies solution-owner access. Outstanding payments must be settled and active campaigns concluded or transferred. Meta notifies partners and cleans up solution resources and permissions. Returns solution state, optionally restricted by fields, or a success acknowledgment as shown in the multi-partner guide. This does not initiate deactivation.

inputs.name: fields
inputs.about: Comma-separated response fields: id, name, status, status_for_pending_request, owner_permissions. Omit for provider defaults: name,status,status_for_pending_request.

inputs.name: solution_id
inputs.about: Multi-Partner Solution ID from WHATSAPP_LIST_BUSINESS_SOLUTIONS, the Meta App Dashboard's Partner solutions panel, or a partner_solutions webhook's solution_id. Requires an ACTIVE solution with PENDING_DEACTIVATION.

tools.name: Add business phone number
tools.description: Add a preverified phone number to a partner-owned pool clients can purchase from. This partner inventory endpoint creates a preverified phone number entity for a WhatsApp Business Account. It is not ordinary WABA phone registration or an SMS verification workflow. The number must not already be registered to another WhatsApp Business Account.

inputs.name: user_agent
inputs.about: Optional User-Agent header identifying the client software.

inputs.name: business_id
inputs.about: WhatsApp Business Account ID used as Business-ID by this partner endpoint. Find it in Meta Business Manager or via the business management APIs.

inputs.name: phone_number
inputs.about: Preverified partner-owned phone number to add. Accepts E.164 or formatted numbers with spaces, hyphens, and parentheses (for example, +1 (631) 555-1000); the provider normalizes and validates it.

tools.name: Approve group join requests
tools.description: Approve pending WhatsApp group join requests by their join request IDs. Use for groups requiring join approval. Approved users can access the group when tapping its invite link. Requires a Groups API-eligible business number. HTTP 200 can include partial failures: inspect approved_join_requests, failed_join_requests, and errors to determine the outcome for each request.

inputs.name: group_id
inputs.about: Group ID from the active groups listing or group creation webhook.

inputs.name: join_requests
inputs.about: Join request IDs to approve. Obtain these from the group's open join requests listing or group_participants_update webhooks; these are not WhatsApp user IDs.

inputs.name: messaging_product
inputs.about: Messaging product; must be whatsapp.

tools.name: Assign user
tools.description: Assign a Facebook user or system user to a WhatsApp Business Account with specified tasks. Grants account access for the supplied permission tasks. Authenticate using a System User access token with admin permissions and provide the intended Facebook user or system user ID. Returns the provider's success flag.

inputs.name: user
inputs.about: Facebook user or system user ID to add. Find Facebook user IDs in Meta business settings or business user management APIs; retrieve system user IDs from /{WHATSAPP_BUSINESS_ACCOUNT_ID}/system_users. Authenticate using a System User access token with admin permissions.

inputs.name: tasks
inputs.about: Permission tasks to grant to the user on the WhatsApp Business Account. MANAGE_BILLING is needed for sharing a Line of Credit. Request the needed granular tasks; MANAGE requires full solution access including MESSAGING for shared Multi-Partner Solutions.

inputs.name: whatsapp_business_account_id
inputs.about: WhatsApp Business Account ID. Find it in Meta Business Manager or account management APIs.

tools.name: Block WhatsApp Users
tools.description: Block one or more WhatsApp users to prevent them from sending messages to your business phone number. Use this action when you need to prevent specific users from contacting your business through WhatsApp. Blocked users will receive an error if they attempt to send messages to your business phone number. This action is irreversible — blocked users cannot unblock themselves and must contact your business directly to be unblocked. Note: You can block a maximum of 100 users per request.

inputs.name: block_users
inputs.about: List of users to block. Each user must be identified by their WhatsApp phone number in international format without the + sign (e.g., '16505551234'). Maximum of 100 users per request.

inputs.name: phone_number_id
inputs.about: The Meta-assigned numeric ID for the WhatsApp Business phone number to block users from. This is NOT the actual phone number itself - it is a numeric ID (e.g., '712594308615206') assigned by Meta. Obtain it using WHATSAPP_GET_PHONE_NUMBERS action which returns the 'id' field for each phone number.

tools.name: Configure WhatsApp Conversational Automation
tools.description: Configure conversational automation for a WhatsApp Business phone number, including welcome-message enablement, custom commands, and ice breaker prompts. The welcome-message setting defaults to false when omitted.

inputs.name: prompts
inputs.about: List of conversation prompts (ice breakers) up to 3 items. Each prompt must be 1-80 characters. These guide customers with suggested conversation starters.

inputs.name: commands
inputs.about: List of bot commands (up to 30) for automated responses. Each command has a name and description. Use this to define custom commands users can trigger.

inputs.name: phone_number_id
inputs.about: The Meta-assigned numeric ID for the WhatsApp Business phone number (e.g., '1234567890123456'). Get this from the WHATSAPP_GET_PHONE_NUMBERS action.

inputs.name: enable_welcome_message
inputs.about: Whether to enable the welcome message for new conversations. When enabled, the first message from a customer will trigger an automated greeting.

tools.name: Create business account
tools.description: Create a WhatsApp Business Account under a business portfolio. Requires portfolio permissions and an app capable of WABA creation. The new account remains pending until verification completes. Returns the WABA and payment account IDs; does not register a phone number or send messages.

inputs.name: name
inputs.about: Human-readable account name; must be unique within the business portfolio.

inputs.name: currency
inputs.about: Billing currency code in ISO 4217 format.

inputs.name: business_id
inputs.about: Business portfolio ID. Find it in Meta Business Suite business settings or business management APIs.

inputs.name: timezone_id
inputs.about: Meta timezone ID for the account.

inputs.name: business_type
inputs.about: WhatsApp Business Account type: ENTERPRISE or SMB.

inputs.name: primary_funding_id
inputs.about: Primary funding source ID (credit card or extended credit), available from your business billing settings. The source must be valid and active.

inputs.name: purchase_order_number
inputs.about: Purchase order number for billing reference.

inputs.name: on_behalf_of_business_id
inputs.about: Business portfolio ID when creating on behalf of another business. Find it in that business's Meta Business Suite settings.

tools.name: Create business solution
tools.description: Create a Multi-Partner Solution between an owner app and a partner app. Requires an eligible Solution Partner, Tech Provider, or Tech Partner setup and an accessible partner app. Assign MESSAGING to exactly one app. Creation initiates the solution and invites the partner; the partner must accept before it can be used with Embedded Signup. Returns the solution ID, not an active solution.

inputs.name: solution_name
inputs.about: Agreed human-readable solution name shown in both partners' dashboards (2–75 characters).

inputs.name: application_id
inputs.about: Solution owner Facebook app ID. Find it in your Meta App Dashboard; the app must have the required partner capabilities.

inputs.name: partner_app_id
inputs.about: Partner Facebook app ID, obtained from your agreed solution partner's Meta App Dashboard. The app must be accessible to the requesting entity.

inputs.name: owner_permissions
inputs.about: Configurable permissions for the owner app: ['MESSAGING'] or []. Exactly one of owner_permissions and partner_permissions must contain MESSAGING; default partner permissions are automatic.

inputs.name: partner_permissions
inputs.about: Configurable permissions for the partner app: ['MESSAGING'] or []. Use [] when the owner handles messaging; exactly one app must receive MESSAGING.

tools.name: Create WhatsApp Flow
tools.description: Create a WhatsApp Flow for the WhatsApp Business Account bound to the connection. The flow starts in draft and must be configured with Flow JSON and published before use.

inputs.name: name
inputs.about: The name of the flow. Maximum 80 characters. Must be unique within your WhatsApp Business Account.

inputs.name: waba_id
inputs.about: Optional: WhatsApp Business Account ID to use. If not provided, uses the waba_id from your connection configuration.

inputs.name: categories
inputs.about: JSON array of category names as a string (e.g., '["OTHER"]'). Each flow must have at least one category. Common categories include: AUTHENTICATION, CONFIRMATION, LEAD_GENERATION, OTHER, etc.

inputs.name: endpoint_uri
inputs.about: The HTTPS URL where your flow logic is hosted. This endpoint must be accessible by Meta's servers. The URL must start with https:// and should respond to incoming flow data requests.

inputs.name: clone_flow_id
inputs.about: Optional: ID of an existing flow to clone. If provided, the new flow will be a copy of the specified flow with the new name and categories. Use this to quickly create variations of existing flows.

tools.name: Create group
tools.description: Submit creation of a WhatsApp group for a business phone number. Requires an eligible Official Business Account using Cloud API. A successful response acknowledges the creation request; the group_lifecycle_update webhook reports creation success or failure and supplies the invite link on success. Omitted join_approval_mode defaults to auto_approve at WhatsApp.

inputs.name: subject
inputs.about: Group subject, at most 128 characters. WhatsApp trims whitespace.

inputs.name: description
inputs.about: Optional group description, at most 2048 characters.

inputs.name: phone_number_id
inputs.about: Business phone number ID. Obtain it from WHATSAPP_GET_PHONE_NUMBERS or WhatsApp Manager.

inputs.name: messaging_product
inputs.about: Messaging product; must be whatsapp.

inputs.name: join_approval_mode
inputs.about: Whether joining via the invite link requires approval. If omitted, WhatsApp defaults to auto_approve.

tools.name: Create group invite link
tools.description: Reset a WhatsApp group's invite link and return its replacement. POST creates a new invite link for an existing group, invalidating all previous invite links. A group's initial link is generated when the group is created. This action rotates that link; it does not retrieve the current link, create a group, or send invitations. Requires an eligible Official Business Account using Cloud API.

inputs.name: group_id
inputs.about: Group ID from the group_lifecycle_update webhook or a group listing/query response. This operation resets that group's invite link.

inputs.name: messaging_product
inputs.about: Messaging product; must be whatsapp.

tools.name: Create WhatsApp Max Price Agreement
tools.description: Create a max price agreement for WhatsApp marketing messages pricing. Max price agreements set a ceiling on the per-conversation price you'll pay for WhatsApp messaging across your WhatsApp Business Account. This is useful for controlling costs and ensuring predictable pricing for your messaging campaigns. Use this action when you need to set up pricing agreements for marketing, utility, or authentication message types on your WhatsApp Business Account. Once created, the agreement will be applied to all applicable conversations.

inputs.name: currency
inputs.about: The 3-letter ISO currency code for the max price (e.g., 'USD', 'EUR', 'INR').

inputs.name: business_id
inputs.about: The WhatsApp Business Account (WABA) ID. This is the numeric ID for your business account, typically starts with a number like '944953772041385'.

inputs.name: signer_name
inputs.about: The full name of the person signing this price agreement.

inputs.name: message_type
inputs.about: The type of message for this price agreement. Use 'marketing' for promotional messages, 'utility' for transactional updates, or 'authentication' for one-time passwords.

inputs.name: signer_email
inputs.about: The email address of the person signing this price agreement. This person will receive confirmation of the agreement.

inputs.name: max_price_micros
inputs.about: The maximum price in micros (1 million micros = 1 unit of currency). For example, 50000 micros = 0.05 in the specified currency.

tools.name: Create message template
tools.description: Create a new message template for the WhatsApp Business Account. Templates must be approved by WhatsApp before they can be used. Templates are required for marketing messages and messages sent outside the 24-hour window.

inputs.name: name
inputs.about: Unique template name. Must be lowercase, alphanumeric with underscores only. Maximum 512 characters. Example: 'order_confirmation_v1'.

inputs.name: category
inputs.about: Template category. AUTHENTICATION: for OTP/verification codes. MARKETING: for promotional content (requires opt-in). UTILITY: for transactional updates like order status, appointments.

inputs.name: language
inputs.about: Template language code in ISO 639-1 format with country code. Examples: 'en_US' (US English), 'es_ES' (Spanish), 'pt_BR' (Brazilian Portuguese).

inputs.name: components
inputs.about: List of template components. Required when creating a template from scratch: must include at least one BODY component, and can optionally include one HEADER and one BUTTONS component. Omit when cloning a Template Library template via library_template_name.

inputs.name: allow_category_change
inputs.about: Optional. Set to true to allow Meta to automatically assign/reassign the template category. If omitted, the template may be rejected due to miscategorization.

inputs.name: library_template_name
inputs.about: Optional. The exact name of a Meta Template Library template to clone (e.g. 'order_confirmation_2'). When set, the template is created from the pre-approved library template instead of from scratch; components should be omitted.

inputs.name: library_template_body_inputs
inputs.about: Optional. Used with library_template_name. Object supplying body-level inputs for the library template (e.g. {'add_contact_number': true, 'add_learn_more_link': true, 'add_security_recommendation': true, 'add_track_package_link': true, 'code_expiration_minutes': 10}).

inputs.name: library_template_button_inputs
inputs.about: Optional. Used with library_template_name. List of button input objects supplying values for the library template's buttons (e.g. [{'type': 'PHONE_NUMBER', 'phone_number': '+15551234567'}] or [{'type': 'URL', 'url': 'https://example.com'}]).

tools.name: Create obo mobility intent
tools.description: Create an On-Behalf-Of mobility intent for an eligible WhatsApp Business Account. Requires an authorized solution provider with access to the WABA and source/target solutions in an eligible state. Initiates a transfer, handover, or related approval or cancellation operation. May trigger partner notifications and approval workflows; successful creation does not mean account migration has completed. The legacy OBO account ownership model is deprecated and replaced by partner-initiated account creation; this v23 endpoint is documented, but eligibility must be confirmed with the provider for the account before use.

inputs.name: body
inputs.about: Mobility intent JSON body, including the source solution and operation type.

inputs.name: waba_id
inputs.about: WhatsApp Business Account ID; discover via owned or shared business account listings. Requires an eligible account accessible to the authorized solution provider.

tools.name: Create phone number
tools.description: Create a phone number registration within a WhatsApp Business Account. Starts onboarding, phone verification (unless pre-verified), and business name review. The account must have an available phone number slot and the number must not already be registered with WhatsApp Business. Can also initiate an on-premises-to-Cloud API migration. Use the phone number GET endpoint to monitor registration status; creation does not imply approval.

inputs.name: cc
inputs.about: Country code for the phone number.

inputs.name: waba_id
inputs.about: WhatsApp Business Account ID where the number will be added. Find it in WhatsApp Manager or the business management APIs.

inputs.name: phone_number
inputs.about: Phone number in E.164 format without the + prefix.

inputs.name: verified_name
inputs.about: Business name to be verified for this phone number.

inputs.name: preverified_id
inputs.about: Pre-verified phone number ID for Business Solution Provider (BSP) scenarios; obtain it from your pre-verification workflow.

inputs.name: migrate_phone_number
inputs.about: Whether this is a migration from the on-premises API to Cloud API.

tools.name: Create QR Code
tools.description: Create a new QR code with a prefilled message for a WhatsApp Business phone number. Use this action when you need to generate a shareable QR code that customers can scan to start a conversation with your business. When scanned, the QR code will automatically populate the message input field with the specified prefilled message, making it easy for customers to initiate contact. The QR code can be configured to generate an image (PNG or SVG format) which will be available in the response for download and sharing.

inputs.name: phone_number_id
inputs.about: The WhatsApp Business Account phone number ID for which to create the QR code. This ID is provided when you add a phone number to your WhatsApp Business Account.

inputs.name: generate_qr_image
inputs.about: Optional. Image format for the generated QR code. When specified, the response will include a qr_image_url field with the QR code image. Supported values: 'PNG' or 'SVG'.

inputs.name: prefilled_message
inputs.about: The pre-filled message text that will appear when customers use the QR code. This is the message they will send to your business when they scan the code.

tools.name: Create schedule
tools.description: Create a campaign schedule for the connection's WhatsApp Business Account. Supply a template (HSM), audience, WABA customer status ID, name, description, and delivery Unix timestamp. Returns the created schedule ID.

inputs.name: waba_id
inputs.about: WhatsApp Business Account ID from WhatsApp Manager. If supplied, must match the connection's WABA ID; otherwise the configured ID is used.

inputs.name: request_body
inputs.about: Required JSON payload for creating a campaign schedule.

tools.name: Create upload session for WhatsApp
tools.description: Create a resumable upload session for large file uploads to WhatsApp. This action initiates an upload session that allows you to upload large files in chunks. First create a session, then use the session ID and URI to upload file data in subsequent requests. This is useful for uploading videos and large images that exceed the size limits of direct uploads. Use this action when you need to upload media files larger than the direct upload limit, or when you want to implement resumable uploads for reliability.

inputs.name: file_name
inputs.about: Optional file name for the upload session. If not provided, a default name will be used.

inputs.name: file_type
inputs.about: The MIME type of the file being uploaded. Supported types: image/jpeg, image/png, video/mp4.

inputs.name: file_length
inputs.about: The size of the file in bytes. Must be a positive integer representing the exact file size.

tools.name: Delete flow
tools.description: Delete a WhatsApp Flow that is in DRAFT status. Use the Flow ID returned by creating or listing Flows. Published Flows cannot be deleted; only DRAFT Flows are eligible for deletion.

inputs.name: flow_id
inputs.about: ID of the Flow to delete. Obtain it from creating or listing Flows. Only Flows in DRAFT status can be deleted.

tools.name: Delete group
tools.description: Delete a WhatsApp group and remove all participants, including the business. Use the group ID returned by listing groups or a group creation webhook. Requires an eligible Official Business Account using Cloud API. Final deletion success or failure is reported through the group_lifecycle_update webhook.

inputs.name: group_id
inputs.about: ID of the WhatsApp group to delete. Obtain it from WHATSAPP_LIST_GROUPS or the group creation lifecycle webhook.

tools.name: Delete group invite link
tools.description: Delete an existing WhatsApp group invite link using the Groups invite link API. Requires the group ID and an eligible Official Business Account using Cloud API. Deletes the invite link, not the group. To reset an invite link and obtain a replacement, use the POST invite link operation instead.

inputs.name: group_id
inputs.about: ID of the WhatsApp group whose invite link to delete. Obtain it from the group creation lifecycle webhook or by listing groups.

inputs.name: messaging_product
inputs.about: Messaging product required by the invite link API. Must be whatsapp.

tools.name: Delete WhatsApp Media
tools.description: Delete a WhatsApp media file previously uploaded via the Media API. Use when you need to remove a media object you uploaded earlier (e.g. to free up storage or to retract content). The deletion is permanent — the media_id will no longer be retrievable. Note: media uploaded via Cloud API is normally retained by Meta for 30 days; this operation removes it before the automatic expiry.

inputs.name: media_id
inputs.about: The WhatsApp media ID to delete (obtained from a prior upload_media call or a webhook).

tools.name: Delete message template
tools.description: Delete a WhatsApp Business Account message template by name, permanently removing all language variants unless a template ID is supplied to target one variant. Deleted template names cannot be reused for 30 days.

inputs.name: name
inputs.about: The name of the template to delete. This will delete all templates with this name across all languages.

inputs.name: hsm_id
inputs.about: Optional. The template's ID. Include this together with 'name' to delete only the single language variant with this template ID, instead of deleting all language variants sharing the name.

inputs.name: waba_id
inputs.about: WhatsApp Business Account ID to target. If not provided, the WhatsApp Business Account ID from the connection metadata is used.

tools.name: Delete preverified number
tools.description: Permanently delete a pre-verified phone number from the pre-verified list. Use the pre-verified node ID supplied by your BSP. Deletion cannot be undone and deleted numbers cannot be recovered. Ensure the number is not in active use before deleting it.

inputs.name: preverified_phone_number_id
inputs.about: Pre-verified phone number ID supplied by your Business Solution Provider (BSP) during pre-verification. This is a node ID, not the phone number itself.

tools.name: Delete QR Code
tools.description: Delete a specific QR code from a WhatsApp Business phone number. Use this action when you need to permanently remove a QR code that is no longer needed. This operation is irreversible — once deleted, the QR code cannot be recovered or recreated with the same identifier. This action permanently deletes the QR code and cannot be undone.

inputs.name: qr_code_id
inputs.about: The unique 14-character identifier of the QR code to delete. This is the code value returned when the QR code was created.

inputs.name: phone_number_id
inputs.about: The WhatsApp Business Account phone number ID that owns the QR code to be deleted. This ID is provided when you add a phone number to your WhatsApp Business Account.

tools.name: Deprecate flow
tools.description: Irreversibly retire a published WhatsApp Flow by marking it DEPRECATED. The Flow must already be published. Deprecation prevents the Flow from being sent or opened, allowing its endpoint to be retired. A deprecated Flow cannot be deleted or restored to a previous state. Use WHATSAPP_LIST_FLOWS to find its ID and WHATSAPP_GET_FLOW to check its status before retiring it.

inputs.name: flow_id
inputs.about: ID of the published Flow to retire. Obtain it from WHATSAPP_LIST_FLOWS or WHATSAPP_CREATE_FLOW, and check its status with WHATSAPP_GET_FLOW. Deprecation is irreversible.

tools.name: Deregister WhatsApp Business Phone Number
tools.description: Deregister a WhatsApp Business phone number from the Cloud API. Use when you need to stop sending messages from a phone number — for example before migrating it to another WhatsApp Business Account, before re-registering with a new PIN, or when retiring the number. After deregistration, the phone number can be registered again via register_phone. Destructive operation: after deregistration the phone number cannot send messages until it is registered again.

inputs.name: phone_number_id
inputs.about: The ID of the phone number to deregister (the same ID used with register_phone).

tools.name: Download media
tools.description: Download a WhatsApp media asset using its short-lived media URL. First obtain the URL with WHATSAPP_GET_MEDIA_INFO or a media webhook. Returns a downloadable file. URLs expire after five minutes; retrieve a new URL if the provider returns 404. Redirects are not followed.

inputs.name: media_url
inputs.about: Absolute HTTPS media URL on lookaside.fbsbx.com returned by WHATSAPP_GET_MEDIA_INFO or an incoming media webhook. URLs expire after 5 minutes; retrieve a fresh URL if expired.

tools.name: Edit message template
tools.description: Edit an existing WhatsApp message template by ID. Components, when supplied, replace ALL existing components. The management guide permits APPROVED, REJECTED, or PAUSED templates; approved templates cannot change category and are limited to 10 edits per 30 days and one per 24 hours. Rejected or paused templates have unlimited edits. Meta reviews changes to approved or paused templates and automatically re-approves them unless review fails. Eligibility and category-dependent limits are enforced by Meta against the existing template state.

inputs.name: category
inputs.about: Updated category. The category of an APPROVED template cannot be edited; omit this field for approved templates.

inputs.name: components
inputs.about: Complete replacement list of template component objects, not a partial component patch. Include all components to retain (HEADER, BODY, FOOTER, BUTTONS, or specialized components). Supply example values when using variables, and media handles for media headers. Component-specific fields such as butt

inputs.name: template_id
inputs.about: Message template ID to edit. Discover IDs with WHATSAPP_GET_MESSAGE_TEMPLATES.

inputs.name: sub_category
inputs.about: Template sub-category for utility templates.

inputs.name: display_format
inputs.about: Display format for the template.

inputs.name: parameter_format
inputs.about: Parameter format for the template's variables.

inputs.name: allow_category_change
inputs.about: Allow Meta to reassign the template category.

inputs.name: message_send_ttl_seconds
inputs.about: Message time-to-live in seconds. Authentication: 30–900; utility: 30–43200; marketing (Marketing Messages API): 43200–2592000. Authentication and utility also accept -1 for 30 days. Limits depend on the existing template category, which need not be supplied in an edit.

inputs.name: cta_url_link_tracking_opted_out
inputs.about: Opt out of CTA URL link tracking.

inputs.name: is_primary_device_delivery_only
inputs.about: Restrict delivery to the primary device only.

tools.name: Get account number
tools.description: Retrieve a WhatsApp Account Number node's status and configuration. Use an account-number ID from WHATSAPP_GET_PHONE_NUMBERS. Returns account status, verification, quality, messaging tier, and certificates as selected with fields. For phone-number throughput and webhook settings instead, use WHATSAPP_GET_PHONE_NUMBER.

inputs.name: fields
inputs.about: Comma-separated fields to retrieve. Omit for provider defaults: id, display_phone_number, status. Available: id, display_phone_number, verified_name, status, quality_rating, country_code, country_dial_code, code_verification_status, name_status, messaging_limit_tier, account_mode, certificate, is_of

inputs.name: account_number_id
inputs.about: WhatsApp Account Number ID, obtained from WHATSAPP_GET_PHONE_NUMBERS on your WhatsApp Business Account. Identifies the account-number entity, not a literal phone number; this operation retrieves account status and configuration rather than the phone-number node's throughput/webhook details.

tools.name: Get WhatsApp Business Account Activities
tools.description: Retrieve a paginated activity history for the WhatsApp Business Account bound to the connection, including administrative actions such as phone number verifications and user additions.

inputs.name: after
inputs.about: Cursor for pagination. Use this to get the next page of results.

inputs.name: limit
inputs.about: Maximum number of activity records to return per page. Default is 25, maximum is 100.

inputs.name: since
inputs.about: Unix timestamp or ISO 8601 date string. Only return activities that occurred after this time.

inputs.name: until
inputs.about: Unix timestamp or ISO 8601 date string. Only return activities that occurred before this time.

inputs.name: before
inputs.about: Cursor for pagination. Use this to get the previous page of results.

inputs.name: fields
inputs.about: Comma-separated list of fields to include in the response. Default includes all available fields.

inputs.name: waba_id
inputs.about: Optional: WhatsApp Business Account ID to query. If not provided, uses the waba_id from your connection configuration.

inputs.name: activity_type
inputs.about: Filter activities by type. Can be a single type or comma-separated list of types (e.g., PHONE_NUMBER_VERIFIED,USER_ADDED).

tools.name: Get assigned business accounts
tools.description: Retrieve one page of WhatsApp Business Accounts assigned to a specific Meta user. Returns account IDs and names. Use paging.cursors.after or before with the corresponding request parameter to navigate pages. The connected app must have permission to read the user's assigned accounts.

inputs.name: after
inputs.about: Next-page cursor from paging.cursors.after.

inputs.name: limit
inputs.about: Maximum accounts per page, from 1 to 100. Provider default is 25.

inputs.name: before
inputs.about: Previous-page cursor from paging.cursors.before.

inputs.name: fields
inputs.about: Comma-separated response fields: id, name. Omit for provider defaults (id, name).

inputs.name: user_id
inputs.about: Meta user ID whose assigned WhatsApp Business Accounts to retrieve. Find the user ID in your solution's or partnership's user management settings or Graph API user lookup.

tools.name: Get assigned users
tools.description: List users assigned to a WhatsApp Business Account in a business context. Returns user details and pagination. Pass an after or before cursor from the response to retrieve another page; this action fetches one page per call.

inputs.name: after
inputs.about: Next-page cursor from paging.cursors.after.

inputs.name: limit
inputs.about: Users per page (1–100); provider default is 25.

inputs.name: before
inputs.about: Previous-page cursor from paging.cursors.before.

inputs.name: fields

inputs.name: waba_id

inputs.name: business

tools.name: Get WhatsApp Business Account Details
tools.description: Retrieve configuration and status details for the WhatsApp Business Account bound to the connection, including account review status, business verification status, timezone, and ownership details.

inputs.name: fields
inputs.about: Comma-separated list of fields to include in the response. Default includes all available fields.

inputs.name: waba_id
inputs.about: WhatsApp Business Account ID to retrieve details for. If not provided, uses the waba_id from your connection configuration.

tools.name: Get business bot
tools.description: Retrieve a WhatsApp Business Bot's prompts, commands and welcome-message setting. Supply the bot ID from Business Manager or bot creation/management APIs. Optionally select the documented node fields with a comma-separated fields string.

inputs.name: fields
inputs.about: Comma-separated fields to retrieve: id, prompts, commands, enable_welcome_message. Omit for the provider defaults (prompts, commands, enable_welcome_message).

inputs.name: waba_bot_id
inputs.about: WhatsApp Business Bot ID, provided when the bot is created and available in Business Manager or through bot management APIs.

tools.name: Get WhatsApp Business Compliance Info
tools.description: Retrieve comprehensive business compliance information for a WhatsApp Business phone number. Returns regulatory and compliance details including entity registration status, grievance officer contact information, and customer care details. Use this action to verify business compliance status, review registered business information, and ensure proper contact details are configured for regulatory requirements. Use when you need to check business registration status, review grievance officer details for legal compliance, or verify customer care contact information for your WhatsApp Business account.

inputs.name: fields
inputs.about: Comma-separated list of fields to retrieve. Available fields: messaging_product, entity_name, entity_type, entity_type_custom, is_registered, grievance_officer_details, customer_care_details, whatsapp_business_account_id. If not specified, returns all default fields.

inputs.name: phone_number_id
inputs.about: The WhatsApp Business phone number ID (e.g., '1234567890123456'). Get this from the WHATSAPP_GET_PHONE_NUMBERS action.

tools.name: Get Business Encryption
tools.description: Retrieve the WhatsApp Business public key and its signature verification status. Use this action when you need to obtain the end-to-end encryption public key for a WhatsApp Business phone number. This is useful for setting up secure messaging integrations and verifying the authenticity of messages. The response includes the base64-encoded public key and its signature status.

inputs.name: fields
inputs.about: Comma-separated list of fields to include in the response. Available fields: business_public_key, business_public_key_signature_status. Default includes both fields.

inputs.name: phone_number_id
inputs.about: Your WhatsApp Business phone number ID. This ID represents the phone number entity and can be obtained from your WhatsApp Business Account phone numbers list.

tools.name: Get business portfolio
tools.description: Retrieve a Meta business portfolio's ID, name and timezone identifier. Supply a business portfolio ID from Meta Business Suite business settings. Optional fields selects the returned information. This reads the portfolio itself, rather than its WhatsApp Business Accounts or phone numbers.

inputs.name: fields
inputs.about: Comma-separated fields to return, for example id,name,timezone_id. Omit to use the provider's default field selection.

inputs.name: business_id
inputs.about: Business portfolio ID, found in Meta Business Suite business settings. Use the portfolio ID, not a WhatsApp Business Account or phone number ID.

tools.name: Get business profile
tools.description: Get the business profile information for a WhatsApp Business phone number. This includes business details like description, address, website, and contact info.

inputs.name: fields
inputs.about: Comma-separated list of fields to retrieve. Default includes all available fields.

inputs.name: phone_number_id
inputs.about: The phone number ID to get the business profile for.

tools.name: Get business profile node
tools.description: Retrieve a WhatsApp Business Profile node by its profile ID. Returns the profile object directly, including its ID and selected business information. This is GET /{profile-id}, distinct from WHATSAPP_GET_BUSINESS_PROFILE, which reads the /whatsapp_business_profile edge of a phone number and extracts an entry from its data array.

inputs.name: fields
inputs.about: Comma-separated fields to retrieve: id,description,email,about,address,vertical,websites,profile_picture_url,verified_name,messaging_product. Omit for the provider's default fields.

inputs.name: whatsapp_business_profile_id
inputs.about: WhatsApp Business Profile node ID, found in WhatsApp Business Manager or through business management APIs. Supply the profile ID, not a phone number ID.

tools.name: Get call permissions
tools.description: Check permission to call one WhatsApp user from a business phone number. Identify the user by phone number or BSUID. Returns their permission state and available calling/permission-request actions with rate limits. Calling must be enabled on the business phone number. This does not request permission or call.

inputs.name: recipient
inputs.about: User's business-scoped user ID (BSUID) or parent BSUID, obtained from messaging webhooks. Can identify the user instead of user_wa_id.

inputs.name: user_wa_id
inputs.about: WhatsApp user's phone number in international format, obtained from your customer or messaging webhook. Required unless recipient is provided.

inputs.name: phone_number_id
inputs.about: Business phone number ID. Discover it with WHATSAPP_GET_PHONE_NUMBERS; this is not the display phone number.

tools.name: Get client WhatsApp Business Accounts
tools.description: Retrieve WhatsApp Business Accounts shared with or managed by a business portfolio. Use this action when you need to get WhatsApp Business Accounts (WABAs) that are client accounts shared with or managed by a specific business portfolio, as opposed to accounts directly owned by that business. This is useful for agencies managing accounts for multiple clients, or for businesses accessing accounts shared with them. The action supports filtering by business type, pagination with cursors, finding specific accounts by ID, and specifying which fields to return.

inputs.name: find
inputs.about: Find a specific WhatsApp Business Account by ID.

inputs.name: after
inputs.about: Cursor for forward pagination. Use the cursor from the previous response to get the next page of results.

inputs.name: limit
inputs.about: Maximum number of WhatsApp Business Accounts to return per page. Default is 25, maximum is 100.

inputs.name: before
inputs.about: Cursor for backward pagination. Use the cursor from the previous response to get the previous page of results.

inputs.name: fields
inputs.about: Comma-separated list of fields to include in the response. Available fields: id, name, account_review_status, purchase_order_number, audiences, ownership_type, subscribed_apps, business_verification_status, country, currency, timezone_id, on_behalf_of_business_info, schedules, is_enabled_for_insight

inputs.name: business_id
inputs.about: The Business ID representing the business portfolio whose client WhatsApp Business Accounts you want to retrieve. This can be found in your Meta Business Suite URL or through business management APIs.

inputs.name: business_type
inputs.about: Filter results by WhatsApp Business Account type (STANDARD or PREMIUM).

tools.name: Get WhatsApp Commerce Settings
tools.description: Get commerce settings for a WhatsApp Business phone number. Retrieves cart and catalog visibility settings for a specific WhatsApp Business phone number. Use this action to check whether shopping cart and product catalog features are enabled for customer interactions. This is useful for managing e-commerce capabilities on your WhatsApp Business account. Use when you need to verify the current commerce configuration of a phone number before enabling shopping features or displaying products to customers.

inputs.name: phone_number_id
inputs.about: The WhatsApp Business phone number ID (e.g., '527759822865714'). Get this from the WHATSAPP_GET_PHONE_NUMBERS action.

tools.name: Get connected client businesses
tools.description: Retrieve one page of client businesses connected to a Meta application. Obtain the application ID from your Meta App Dashboard. Returns business IDs and names, with pagination cursors when available. Pass paging.cursors.after as after to fetch the next page, or paging.cursors.before as before to go back. This is application-level client discovery, not the caller's owned-WABA list; use WHATSAPP_GET_OWNED_BUSINESS_ACCOUNTS for that. The provider's app access rules determine which client businesses the connected credential can read.

inputs.name: after
inputs.about: Next-page cursor from paging.cursors.after in a prior response.

inputs.name: limit
inputs.about: Maximum businesses per page (1–100). The provider defaults to 25 when omitted.

inputs.name: before
inputs.about: Previous-page cursor from paging.cursors.before in a prior response.

inputs.name: fields
inputs.about: Comma-separated fields to retrieve: id, name. When omitted, the provider returns id and name.

inputs.name: application_id
inputs.about: Meta Application ID, found in your Meta App Dashboard when you create an application. This is an application ID, not a WhatsApp Business Account ID.

tools.name: Get extended credits
tools.description: Retrieve one page of a Meta Business Portfolio's extended credit lines. Use this to discover credit line IDs, legal entities and requested balances before a credit-sharing workflow. Supply a Business Portfolio ID. Use the returned before/after cursors to navigate pages and fields to select details. Solution Partners need a system user token whose user has an Admin or Financial Editor role on the portfolio.

inputs.name: after
inputs.about: Next-page cursor from paging.cursors.after.

inputs.name: limit
inputs.about: Requested number of credit lines per page.

inputs.name: before
inputs.about: Previous-page cursor from paging.cursors.before.

inputs.name: fields
inputs.about: Comma-separated response fields: id, credit_type, balance, credit_available, max_balance, online_max_balance, allocated_amount, partition_from, owner_business, owner_business_name, is_automated_experience, legal_entity_name, send_bill_to_biz_name, liable_biz_name, receiving_credit_allocation_config,

inputs.name: business_id
inputs.about: Meta Business Portfolio ID, not a WhatsApp Business Account ID. Find it in Meta Business Suite > Business Settings > Business Info, or with WHATSAPP_GET_BUSINESS_PORTFOLIO.

inputs.name: order_by_is_owned_credential
inputs.about: When true, order owning credentials before receiving credentials.

tools.name: Get flow
tools.description: Get one WhatsApp Flow's metadata, validation errors, preview, or health. Supply a Flow ID from creation or the owning account's Flow listing. Omit fields for the provider's default metadata, or select fields and expressions to retrieve a preview link or check health for a specific business number. This read operation can also mutate preview links: if the caller requests preview.invalidate(true), it generates a new link and invalidates the previous one. Preview links are shareable without login.

inputs.name: fields
inputs.about: Graph API fields expression. Omit to return id, name, status, categories, and validation_errors. Available fields: id, name, categories, preview, status, validation_errors, json_version, data_api_version, endpoint_uri, whatsapp_business_account, application, health_status. Use preview.invalidate(fal

inputs.name: flow_id
inputs.about: Flow ID returned when creating a Flow, or obtained by listing Flows for the owning WhatsApp Business Account.

tools.name: Get Flow Assets
tools.description: List assets associated with a WhatsApp Flow. Use this action when you need to retrieve the assets (such as flow.json) that are associated with a WhatsApp Flow. The response includes download URLs for each asset that can be used to fetch the actual content. Note: The download URLs are typically valid for a limited time period and should be used promptly after retrieval.

inputs.name: flow_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the flow. This is the ID assigned by Meta when the flow is created.

tools.name: Get group
tools.description: Retrieve metadata about one WhatsApp group by its group ID. Use fields to select group settings, participants, and participant count. Omitting fields leaves the provider's minimal default response unchanged.

inputs.name: fields
inputs.about: Comma-separated fields to return: id, messaging_product, join_approval_mode, subject, description, suspended, creation_timestamp, participants, total_participant_count. Omit to use the provider's minimal default response.

inputs.name: group_id
inputs.about: Group ID obtained from group creation, a group lifecycle webhook, or the active groups listing for your business phone number.

tools.name: Get Join Requests
tools.description: Retrieve pending join requests for a WhatsApp group to help manage group membership. Results support before and after cursor pagination, with a page size of 1–100 requests.

inputs.name: after
inputs.about: Cursor that points to the end of a page of data to retrieve the next page of results. Use the 'after' cursor from the previous response's paging.cursors.

inputs.name: limit
inputs.about: Maximum number of join requests to return per page (1-100).

inputs.name: before
inputs.about: Cursor that points to the beginning of a page of data to retrieve the previous page of results. Use the 'before' cursor from the previous response's paging.cursors.

inputs.name: group_id
inputs.about: The unique ID of the WhatsApp group to retrieve join requests for.

tools.name: Get max price agreements
tools.description: Check the max price beta agreement status for a Meta business portfolio. Returns none, pending, or accepted and the signer details when present. Use this to check enrollment in the Marketing Messages API max price beta. The agreement is signed once per Meta Business Suite, including for Solution Partners managing eligible clients. This read does not send an agreement email.

inputs.name: business_id
inputs.about: Meta Business Suite (business portfolio) ID. Find it in Meta Business Suite business settings; this is not a WhatsApp Business Account or phone number ID.

tools.name: Get media info
tools.description: Get metadata and download URL for uploaded WhatsApp media. Returns media ID, download URL (valid for 5 minutes), MIME type, SHA256 hash, and file size. The download URL can be used to retrieve the actual media file.

inputs.name: media_id
inputs.about: The WhatsApp media ID to retrieve information for (obtained from media upload or webhook notifications).

tools.name: Get WhatsApp Message History
tools.description: Retrieve message history for a WhatsApp Business phone number. Returns a paginated list of messages with their delivery status information, including events like delivery status updates, timestamps, and webhook information. Use this action when you need to track message delivery status, audit message history, or retrieve detailed information about specific messages. Use when you want to check if messages were delivered, track message status changes, or retrieve delivery receipts for WhatsApp Business messages.

inputs.name: after
inputs.about: Cursor for pagination. Use this to get the next page of results. This value comes from the 'paging.cursors.after' field in previous responses.

inputs.name: limit
inputs.about: Maximum number of message history entries to return per page. Default is 25, maximum is 100.

inputs.name: before
inputs.about: Cursor for pagination. Use this to get the previous page of results. This value comes from the 'paging.cursors.before' field in previous responses.

inputs.name: fields
inputs.about: Comma-separated list of fields to include in the response. If not specified, default fields will be returned (id, message_id). Available fields: id, message_id, events{delivery_status,webhook_update_state,timestamp,application,webhook_uri,error_description}

inputs.name: message_id
inputs.about: Filter results by a specific WhatsApp message ID (WAMID). When provided, only message history for this specific message will be returned.

inputs.name: phone_number_id
inputs.about: The WhatsApp Business phone number ID. This is the ID associated with your registered phone number in WhatsApp Business Manager.

tools.name: Get message history events
tools.description: Retrieve one page of delivery status events for a Message History ID. Obtain the entry ID from message history APIs, then inspect status transitions, occurrence timestamps, application details, or webhook updates. Use the returned before/after cursors to request additional pages.

inputs.name: after
inputs.about: Next-page cursor from paging.cursors.after.

inputs.name: limit
inputs.about: Events per page; provider default is 25, maximum 100.

inputs.name: before
inputs.about: Previous-page cursor from paging.cursors.before.

inputs.name: fields
inputs.about: Comma-separated Graph fields. Available: cursor, node{id,delivery_status,error_description,occurrence_timestamp,status_timestamp,application,webhook_update_state,webhook_uri}. Defaults to cursor,node{id,delivery_status,occurrence_timestamp} when omitted.

inputs.name: delivery_status
inputs.about: Return only events with this delivery status.

inputs.name: message_history_id
inputs.about: Message History ID obtained from message history APIs (the entry's id, not a phone number ID or message WAMID).

tools.name: Get message templates
tools.description: Get all message templates for the WhatsApp Business Account. Templates are required for sending messages outside the 24-hour window and for marketing/utility messages.

inputs.name: after
inputs.about: Cursor for pagination to get templates after this cursor.

inputs.name: limit
inputs.about: The maximum number of templates to retrieve. Default is 25.

inputs.name: fields
inputs.about: Optional comma-separated list of template fields to include in the response (e.g. 'name,status,category,language,components'). If omitted, the API returns its default set of fields.

inputs.name: status
inputs.about: Filter by template status: APPROVED, PENDING, REJECTED, DISABLED, PAUSED, LIMIT_EXCEEDED.

inputs.name: waba_id
inputs.about: Optional: WhatsApp Business Account ID to query. If not provided, uses the waba_id from your connection configuration. Only provide this if you need to override the configured WABA ID.

inputs.name: category
inputs.about: Filter by template category: AUTHENTICATION, MARKETING, UTILITY.

inputs.name: language
inputs.about: Filter by language code (e.g., 'en_US', 'es_ES').

inputs.name: name_or_content
inputs.about: Filter templates by name or content substring.

tools.name: Get migration intent
tools.description: Retrieve a WhatsApp Business Account migration intent's status and linked accounts. Use the ID obtained when creating the migration intent to monitor its lifecycle, check migration progress, or inspect its source, destination, and solution.

inputs.name: fields
inputs.about: Comma-separated response fields: id, status, destination_waba, solution, waba. Omit to use provider defaults (solution, status, destination_waba).

inputs.name: migration_intent_id
inputs.about: Migration intent ID returned when creating the migration intent; discover it through migration management APIs.

tools.name: Get official business account status
tools.description: Retrieve Official Business Account (OBA) application status for a business phone number. Use this to monitor verification progress or read its status message. Obtain the phone number ID from WHATSAPP_GET_PHONE_NUMBERS. This only reads status; it does not submit an OBA application.

inputs.name: fields
inputs.about: Comma-separated response fields: oba_status, status_message. Omit to request the provider's default fields (oba_status, status_message).

inputs.name: phone_number_id
inputs.about: WhatsApp Business phone number ID. Obtain it using WHATSAPP_GET_PHONE_NUMBERS; this is not the display phone number or WABA ID.

tools.name: Get owned WhatsApp Business Accounts
tools.description: Retrieve WhatsApp Business Accounts owned by a business portfolio. Use this action when you need to get all WhatsApp Business Accounts (WABAs) that are directly owned by a specific business. This differs from client accounts which are shared with the business. This is useful for managing your own accounts, querying their details, and navigating through paginated results. The action supports filtering by business type, pagination with cursors, finding specific accounts by ID, and specifying which fields to return.

inputs.name: find
inputs.about: Find a specific WhatsApp Business Account by ID within the owned accounts. Use this to quickly locate a specific account.

inputs.name: last
inputs.about: Number of results to return in backward pagination. Maximum value is 100. Use with 'before' cursor for backward pagination.

inputs.name: after
inputs.about: Cursor for forward pagination. Use the cursor from the previous response to get the next page of results.

inputs.name: first
inputs.about: Number of results to return in forward pagination. Maximum value is 100. Use with 'after' cursor for forward pagination.

inputs.name: before
inputs.about: Cursor for backward pagination. Use the cursor from the previous response to get the previous page of results.

inputs.name: fields
inputs.about: Comma-separated list of fields to include in the response. Available fields: id, name, account_review_status, purchase_order_number, audiences, ownership_type, subscribed_apps, business_verification_status, country, currency, timezone_id, on_behalf_of_business_info, schedules, is_enabled_for_insight

inputs.name: business_id
inputs.about: The Business ID representing the business portfolio that owns the WhatsApp Business Accounts. This can be found in your Business Manager settings.

inputs.name: business_type
inputs.about: Filter accounts by business type. Can specify multiple types like ENTERPRISE or SMB to filter between enterprise and small-medium business accounts.

tools.name: Get phone number
tools.description: Retrieve detailed information about a specific WhatsApp Business phone number. Returns phone number details including verification status, quality rating, display number, verified business name, throughput limits, and webhook configuration. Use this to check phone number status, settings, and capabilities. To get available phone number IDs, first call WHATSAPP_GET_PHONE_NUMBERS.

inputs.name: fields
inputs.about: Comma-separated list of fields to retrieve. Available fields: id, display_phone_number, verified_name, code_verification_status, quality_rating, platform_type, throughput, webhook_configuration, last_onboarded_time. Default retrieves all available fields.

inputs.name: phone_number_id
inputs.about: The WhatsApp Business phone number ID (e.g., '901139066420489'). Get this from the WHATSAPP_GET_PHONE_NUMBERS action.

tools.name: Get phone numbers
tools.description: Retrieve a page of phone numbers registered to the connection's WhatsApp Business Account. Results can include phone number IDs, display numbers, verification status, quality ratings, throughput limits, and paging information.

inputs.name: limit
inputs.about: Maximum number of phone numbers to return per page (1-100). Use lower values for faster responses or when you only need a few numbers.

inputs.name: waba_id
inputs.about: Optional: WhatsApp Business Account ID to query. If not provided, uses the waba_id from your connection configuration. Only provide this if you need to override the configured WABA ID.

tools.name: Get preverified number
tools.description: Retrieve a pre-verified phone number's verification status, owner, and expiry. Supply the pre-verified number ID from your Business Solution Provider or WHATSAPP_LIST_PREVERIFIED_NUMBERS. Optionally select response fields.

inputs.name: fields
inputs.about: Comma-separated response fields: id, code_verification_status, code_verification_time, owner_business, phone_number, verification_expiry_time. Omit to use provider defaults.

inputs.name: preverified_phone_number_id
inputs.about: Pre-verified phone number ID provided by your Business Solution Provider during pre-verification, or discovered through WHATSAPP_LIST_PREVERIFIED_NUMBERS.

tools.name: Get preverified number partners
tools.description: List partner businesses with access to a pre-verified WhatsApp phone number. Returns one page of Business nodes, with id and name by default. Select additional Business fields with fields; use before or after to navigate pages.

inputs.name: after
inputs.about: Next-page cursor from paging.cursors.after.

inputs.name: limit
inputs.about: Maximum partner businesses per page (1–100). The provider defaults to 25 when omitted.

inputs.name: before
inputs.about: Previous-page cursor from paging.cursors.before.

inputs.name: fields

inputs.name: pre_verified_phone_number_id
inputs.about: Pre-verified phone number ID, provided when created or found in WhatsApp Business Account management. This is not the phone number itself.

tools.name: Get qr code
tools.description: Retrieve one message QR code by phone number ID and QR code identifier. Returns its code, pre-filled message and deep link in a data array. inputs.about: Comma-separated fields to retrieve: code, prefilled_message, deep_link_url (always included), creation_time (first-party apps only), and qr_image_url.format(SVG) or qr_image_url.format(PNG). For example: code,prefilled_message,qr_image_url.format(SVG).

inputs.name: phone_number_id
inputs.about: WhatsApp Business phone number ID that owns the QR code. Obtain it from WHATSAPP_GET_PHONE_NUMBERS.

tools.name: Get reach estimate
tools.description: Estimate WhatsApp marketing message reach and costs at different max prices. This beta planning tool returns delivery and cost ranges, not guarantees of future performance. Supply geographic targeting and a historical lookback; this does not send messages.

inputs.name: targeting_spec

tools.name: Get WhatsApp Schedules

inputs.name: sort

tools.name: Get WhatsApp Cloud API Settings

inputs.name: phone_number_id

tools.name: Get solution access token

Supply the explicit solution ID and customer's business portfolio ID from account_update; authenticate with the partner's authorized system user token. Meta enforces partner and asset authorization. This does not retrieve the connection's authentication token or grant access to arbitrary businesses. Store the returned client token securely and never log or disclose it.

inputs.name: solution_id

tools.name: Get Subscribed Apps
tools.description: Get all applications currently subscribed to webhooks for a WhatsApp Business Account. Use this action when you need to retrieve the list of third-party applications or integrations that are subscribed to receive webhook events for a specific WABA.

inputs.name: fields
inputs.about: Comma-separated list of fields to include in the response. Available fields: id, name, link.

inputs.name: waba_id
inputs.about: Optional: WhatsApp Business Account ID to query. If not provided, uses the waba_id from your connection configuration. Only provide this if you need to override the configured WABA ID.

tools.name: Get message template library
tools.description: Browse the pre-built message template library for WhatsApp Business Account. This retrieves a list of available templates that can be used for messaging. Use when you need to discover available message templates for sending marketing, utility, or authentication messages to WhatsApp users.

inputs.name: after
inputs.about: Cursor for pagination to get templates after this cursor.

inputs.name: limit
