inputs.name: status
inputs.about: Filter by template status: APPROVED, PENDING, REJECTED, DISABLED, PAUSED, LIMIT_EXCEEDED.

inputs.name: country
inputs.about: Filter by country code (e.g., 'US', 'GB').

inputs.name: category
inputs.about: Filter by template category: AUTHENTICATION, MARKETING, UTILITY.

inputs.name: language
inputs.about: Filter by language code (e.g., 'en_US', 'es_ES').

inputs.name: name_or_content
inputs.about: Filter templates by name or content substring.

tools.name: Get template status
tools.description: Get the status and details of a specific message template. This is useful for checking if a template has been approved, rejected, or is still pending review.

inputs.name: fields
inputs.about: Comma-separated list of fields to retrieve. Valid fields include: id, name, status, category, language, components, previous_category, parameter_format, quality_score, rejected_reason. If not specified, returns all default fields.

inputs.name: template_id
inputs.about: The ID of the template to check the status for.

tools.name: Get upload offset
tools.description: Get the byte offset of an interrupted resumable upload. Use the session ID returned by WHATSAPP_CREATE_UPLOAD_SESSION, then pass the returned file_offset and remaining bytes to WHATSAPP_UPLOAD_FILE_CHUNK. The Resumable Upload API requires a user access token in the auth header.

inputs.name: upload_session_id
inputs.about: Session ID returned by WHATSAPP_CREATE_UPLOAD_SESSION. Pass the returned id, including upload: and any ?sig= signature, unchanged; a bare session ID is also accepted.

tools.name: List blocked users
tools.description: Retrieve one page of blocked users for a WhatsApp Business phone number. Returns data entries with messaging_product and wa_id, plus paging.cursors. Pass the returned after or before cursor to retrieve another page.

inputs.name: after
inputs.about: Forward pagination cursor from paging.cursors.after.

inputs.name: limit
inputs.about: Maximum number of blocked users to return in this page.

inputs.name: before
inputs.about: Backward pagination cursor from paging.cursors.before.

inputs.name: phone_number_id
inputs.about: WhatsApp Business phone number ID. Discover it with WHATSAPP_GET_PHONE_NUMBERS.

tools.name: List business accounts
tools.description: List WhatsApp Business Accounts owned by a business portfolio. Uses Meta's owned_whatsapp_business_accounts edge, the same owned-account resource as WHATSAPP_GET_OWNED_BUSINESS_ACCOUNTS. For accounts shared by other businesses, use WHATSAPP_GET_CLIENT_BUSINESS_ACCOUNTS instead. Use its business_type/find filters and limit/after/before pagination to return one page. Authenticate with a credential authorized to read this portfolio.

inputs.name: find
inputs.about: Find a specific owned WABA by its ID from an account listing.

inputs.name: after
inputs.about: Next-page cursor from paging.cursors.after.

inputs.name: limit
inputs.about: Accounts per page (1–100); provider default: 25.

inputs.name: before
inputs.about: Previous-page cursor from paging.cursors.before.

inputs.name: fields
inputs.about: Comma-separated response fields: id, name, account_review_status, purchase_order_number, currency, timezone_id, business_verification_status, country, on_behalf_of_business_info, is_enabled_for_insights, message_template_namespace. Provider defaults: id,name,currency,timezone_id.

inputs.name: business_id
inputs.about: Business portfolio ID, found in Meta Business Suite or through business management APIs.

inputs.name: business_type
inputs.about: Filter by WhatsApp Business Account types.

tools.name: List business solutions
tools.description: List one page of Multi-Partner Solutions owned by or partnered with a Meta app. Use an Application ID from the App Dashboard and optionally filter by OWNER or PARTNER. Continue with returned paging cursors. This application-level listing differs from WHATSAPP_LIST_SOLUTIONS, which lists solutions that onboarded a WABA. Partner eligibility and access to the application are required by Meta.

inputs.name: role
inputs.about: Filter by the application's relationship to the solution. Omit to include both owned and partnered solutions.

inputs.name: after
inputs.about: Next-page cursor from paging.cursors.after.

inputs.name: limit
inputs.about: Solutions per page (1–100); provider default: 25.

inputs.name: before
inputs.about: Previous-page cursor from paging.cursors.before.

inputs.name: fields
inputs.about: Comma-separated fields: id, name, status, status_for_pending_request, owner_app, owner_permissions. Provider defaults: name,status,status_for_pending_request.

inputs.name: application_id
inputs.about: Meta Application ID from the App Dashboard. Use an application ID, not a WhatsApp Business Account (WABA) ID.

tools.name: List WhatsApp Flows
tools.description: List all WhatsApp Flows associated with the WhatsApp Business Account. Returns flow details including name, status, categories, and any validation errors. Use when you need to retrieve all available flows to select one for messaging or to check the status of existing flows.

inputs.name: after
inputs.about: Cursor for pagination to get flows after this cursor.

inputs.name: limit
inputs.about: The maximum number of flows to retrieve per page (1-100). Default is 25. Use lower values for faster responses.

inputs.name: waba_id
inputs.about: Optional: WhatsApp Business Account ID to query. If not provided, uses the waba_id from your connection configuration. Only provide this if you need to override the configured WABA ID.

tools.name: List WhatsApp Groups
tools.description: List all WhatsApp groups associated with a business phone number. Use this action when you need to retrieve the list of groups that a business phone number is a member of. This is useful for managing group memberships, sending messages to groups, or auditing group participation. Results can be paginated using the 'after' and 'before' cursors from the paging response.

inputs.name: after
inputs.about: Cursor that points to the end of a page of data to retrieve the next page of results. Use the 'after' cursor from the previous response's paging.cursors.

inputs.name: limit
inputs.about: Maximum number of groups to return per page (1-100). Use lower values for faster responses or when you only need a few groups.

inputs.name: before
inputs.about: Cursor that points to the beginning of a page of data to retrieve the previous page of results. Use the 'before' cursor from the previous response's paging.cursors.

inputs.name: phone_number_id
inputs.about: The Meta-assigned numeric ID for the WhatsApp Business phone number. This is NOT the actual phone number itself - it is a numeric ID (e.g., '712594308615206') assigned by Meta. Obtain it using WHATSAPP_GET_PHONE_NUMBERS action which returns the 'id' field for each phone number.

tools.name: List on behalf requests
tools.description: List one page of in-progress on-behalf requests for a WhatsApp Business Account. Returns pending business relationship requests and optionally the receiving and requesting businesses. Continue using the returned before/after cursors. The legacy On-Behalf-Of (OBO) ownership model was replaced by partner-initiated account creation: client transfers were due October 1, 2025, with eligible accounts scheduled for batch migration through the end of 2025. This model retirement does not establish removal of this operation; the v23 reference does not mark the operation deprecated. Access requires an authorized partner principal and an accessible WABA with relevant OBO requests.

inputs.name: after
inputs.about: Forward pagination cursor from paging.cursors.after.

inputs.name: limit
inputs.about: Results per page (1–100); provider default: 25.

inputs.name: before
inputs.about: Backward pagination cursor from paging.cursors.before.

inputs.name: fields
inputs.about: Comma-separated fields: id, status, business_owned_object, receiving_business, requesting_business. Provider defaults: id,status,business_owned_object.

inputs.name: waba_id
inputs.about: WhatsApp Business Account ID from WhatsApp Business Manager or the account listing APIs; not a phone number ID.

tools.name: List preverified numbers
tools.description: List pre-verified phone numbers available to a business portfolio. Optionally filter by phone number or verification status and select response fields. Returns one page; pass the returned before or after cursor to navigate pages.

inputs.name: after
inputs.about: Next-page cursor from a previous response's paging.cursors.after.

inputs.name: limit
inputs.about: Maximum number of phone numbers to return per page.

inputs.name: before
inputs.about: Previous-page cursor from a previous response's paging.cursors.before.

inputs.name: fields
inputs.about: Comma-separated response fields: id, code_verification_status, code_verification_time, owner_business, phone_number, verification_expiry_time.

inputs.name: business_id
inputs.about: Business portfolio ID. Find it in Meta Business Manager or through business management APIs.

inputs.name: phone_number
inputs.about: Return only pre-verified numbers matching this phone number.

inputs.name: code_verification_status
inputs.about: Filter numbers by verification status.

tools.name: List qr codes
tools.description: Get a list of all QR codes for a WhatsApp Business phone number. Use this action when you need to retrieve all message QR codes associated with a specific WhatsApp Business phone number. This is useful for managing existing QR codes, checking their status, or obtaining their image URLs for display. The action supports pagination through the 'after' and 'before' parameters, and can filter results by a specific QR code ID.

inputs.name: code
inputs.about: Filter results to a specific QR code by its unique identifier.

inputs.name: after
inputs.about: Cursor for pagination. Use this to get the next page of results. Obtain this value from the paging.cursors.after field in previous responses.

inputs.name: limit
inputs.about: Maximum number of QR codes to return in a single response. Default is 25.

inputs.name: before
inputs.about: Cursor for pagination. Use this to get the previous page of results. Obtain this value from the paging.cursors.before field in previous responses.

inputs.name: fields
inputs.about: Comma-separated list of fields to include in the response. Available fields: code, prefilled_message, deep_link_url, creation_time (first-party apps only), qr_image_url.format(SVG|PNG). Example: 'code,prefilled_message,deep_link_url,qr_image_url.format(SVG)'

inputs.name: phone_number_id
inputs.about: The WhatsApp Business Account phone number ID for which to list QR codes. This ID is provided when you add a phone number to your WhatsApp Business Account.

tools.name: List WhatsApp Solutions
tools.description: Retrieve a paginated list of Multi-Partner Solutions for the WhatsApp Business Account configured on the connection, including status and owner application information when returned.

inputs.name: after
inputs.about: Cursor for pagination. Returns solutions after this cursor position. Use the cursor from the previous response's paging.cursors.after field.

inputs.name: limit
inputs.about: Maximum number of solutions to return per page (1-100). Default is 25.

inputs.name: before
inputs.about: Cursor for pagination. Returns solutions before this cursor position. Use the cursor from the previous response's paging.cursors.before field.

inputs.name: fields
inputs.about: Comma-separated list of fields to include in the response. If not specified, default fields will be returned (id, name, status, status_for_pending_request). Available fields: id, name, status, status_for_pending_request, owner_app, owner_permissions.

inputs.name: waba_id
inputs.about: Optional: WhatsApp Business Account ID to query. If not provided, uses the waba_id from your connection configuration. Only provide this if you need to override the configured WABA ID.

tools.name: Manage call
tools.description: Initiate, pre-accept, accept, reject or terminate a WhatsApp WebRTC call. Calling must be enabled on the business number. Outbound connect requires the user's calling permission. Supply an SDP offer for connect or an SDP answer for pre_accept/accept when sending a session. This sends signaling requests; the caller must operate a WebRTC media stack. Pre-accept establishes the media connection; start media only after accept returns 200 OK. Inbound calls must normally be accepted within 30–60 seconds of the Call Connect webhook.

inputs.name: to
inputs.about: Callee phone number for connect; required unless recipient is supplied. Takes precedence over recipient.

inputs.name: action
inputs.about: Call operation. connect starts an outbound call; other actions use call_id.

inputs.name: call_id
inputs.about: Required except for connect. Get from the inbound Call Connect webhook or outbound connect response.

inputs.name: session
inputs.about: Optional WebRTC SDP for connect (offer), pre_accept or accept (answer). On accept, match any previously supplied pre_accept answer.

inputs.name: recipient
inputs.about: Callee BSUID or parent BSUID for connect, obtained from user/contact webhooks; alternative or addition to to.

inputs.name: recording
inputs.about: Optional recording configuration for connect or accept, independent of transcription.

inputs.name: transcription
inputs.about: Optional transcription configuration for connect or accept, independent of recording.

inputs.name: phone_number_id
inputs.about: Business phone number ID; discover with WHATSAPP_GET_PHONE_NUMBERS.

inputs.name: messaging_account_id
inputs.about: Messaging account ID from onboarding/account discovery. Include when the token has messaging access to multiple accounts on this number; keep the same value for every request for a call.

inputs.name: biz_opaque_callback_data
inputs.about: Optional tracking string for connect or accept, echoed in call webhooks.

tools.name: Migrate flows
tools.description: Copy up to 100 Flows between WABAs owned by the same Meta business. Copies keep their names and published/draft state, and receive new IDs. Source Flows remain unchanged. A name already present in the destination fails for that Flow while other Flows can succeed; inspect failed_flows even when the request succeeds. Omit source_flow_names to copy all source Flows, subject to the 100-Flow request limit.

inputs.name: source_waba_id
inputs.about: Source WhatsApp Business Account ID. Find it in Meta Business Settings > WhatsApp Accounts. Source Flows remain unchanged.

inputs.name: source_flow_names
inputs.about: Names of source Flows to copy, as returned by WHATSAPP_LIST_FLOWS. Omit to copy all source Flows. Only 100 Flows can be migrated per request.

inputs.name: destination_waba_id
inputs.about: Destination WhatsApp Business Account ID. Find it in Meta Business Settings > WhatsApp Accounts. Must be owned by the same Meta business as the source account.

tools.name: Onboard marketing partners
tools.description: Send a partner-initiated MM Lite onboarding request to an end business. Validates partner business and app permissions and end business eligibility, identifies eligible shared and on-behalf-of (OBO) WhatsApp Business Accounts, and creates a business agreement request. Business Solution Providers (BSPs) can create OBO WABAs and set mobility intents on eligible OBO WABAs; Technology Partners can only create onboarding requests, without OBO WABA management. Returns the existing request ID when the same partner and end business already have a pending request. Does not send a marketing message.

inputs.name: business_id
inputs.about: End business portfolio ID that will receive the onboarding request, not the requesting partner's ID. Obtain it from the end business's Meta Business Suite business settings.

inputs.name: solution_id
inputs.about: Optional WhatsApp Business Solution ID from your partner solution configuration. Associates the solution with the business agreement and OBO mobility intents.

tools.name: Publish WhatsApp Flow
tools.description: Publish a WhatsApp Flow to make it available for use. Use this action when you have finished designing and testing a WhatsApp Flow and are ready to make it available for users. The flow must be in DRAFT status and pass all validation checks before it can be published. Note: Once published, the flow cannot be unpublished. To make changes, you will need to create a new version of the flow.

inputs.name: flow_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the flow to publish. This is the ID assigned by Meta when the flow is created.

tools.name: Register WhatsApp Business Phone Number
tools.description: Register a WhatsApp Business phone number for use with WhatsApp Cloud API. Use when you need to register a phone number that has been added to your WhatsApp Business Account. This action requires setting up a two-step verification PIN (6 digits) for the phone number. The phone number must be verified and properly configured in WhatsApp Manager before registration. Note: Registration is required before you can send messages from this phone number. Once registered, the phone number will be associated with your WhatsApp Business Account.

inputs.name: pin
inputs.about: 6-digit PIN for two-step verification setup. The PIN must be exactly 6 digits.

inputs.name: backup
inputs.about: Backup data for migrating existing WhatsApp Business accounts.

inputs.name: phone_number_id
inputs.about: The ID of the phone number to register. This ID is provided when the phone number is added to your WhatsApp Business Account and can be found in WhatsApp Manager.

inputs.name: messaging_product
inputs.about: Must be 'whatsapp' to indicate WhatsApp Business messaging product.

inputs.name: data_localization_region
inputs.about: Data localization regions for message storage.

inputs.name: meta_store_retention_minutes
inputs.about: Message retention period in minutes (deprecated in v21+). Only 60 minutes is allowed.

tools.name: Reject business solution
tools.description: Reject a pending partnership or deactivation request for a Multi-Partner Solution. Requires an eligible partner app with access to the solution. Partnership rejection requires the requesting partner's app ID. Rejection is permanent; rejected requests may need resubmission. An accepted partnership cannot be declined. Returns the rejection status and any available rejection details.

inputs.name: solution_id
inputs.about: Multi-Partner Solution ID from App Dashboard > WhatsApp > Partner solutions, solution management APIs, or the partner_solutions webhook's solution_id.

inputs.name: request_type
inputs.about: Type of pending request to reject: a partnership invitation or a solution deactivation request.

inputs.name: partner_app_id
inputs.about: Requesting partner's Meta app ID, obtained from the partner or solution details. Required for PARTNERSHIP_REQUEST; not used for DEACTIVATION_REQUEST.

inputs.name: rejection_reason
inputs.about: Optional reason for rejecting the request (at most 500 characters).

tools.name: Reject group join requests
tools.description: Reject pending requests to join a WhatsApp group, individually or in bulk. Requires a Groups API-eligible business number. Get join request IDs from the group's open join requests or group_participants_update webhooks. Rejected users see the Request to join button again on the invite link. HTTP 200 can include partial failures: inspect rejected_join_requests, failed_join_requests and errors before treating every rejection as successful.

inputs.name: group_id
inputs.about: Group ID from group creation webhooks or the active groups listing.

inputs.name: join_requests
inputs.about: Join request IDs to reject. Obtain IDs from the group's open join requests listing or group_participants_update webhooks.

inputs.name: messaging_product
inputs.about: Messaging product; must be whatsapp.

tools.name: Reject solution deactivation
tools.description: Reject a pending Multi-Partner Solution deactivation request. Keeps the solution ACTIVE and clears PENDING_DEACTIVATION to NONE, preserving its configuration, permissions, and ability to onboard clients. Partners are notified of the rejection. Requires an eligible solution partnership and a pending deactivation request; the multi-partner guide specifies solution-owner access. Returns solution state, optionally restricted by fields.

inputs.name: fields
inputs.about: Comma-separated response fields: id, name, status, status_for_pending_request, owner_app, owner_permissions. Omit for provider defaults: name,status,status_for_pending_request.

inputs.name: solution_id
inputs.about: Multi-Partner Solution ID with a pending deactivation request. Find it in WHATSAPP_LIST_BUSINESS_SOLUTIONS, the App Dashboard's Partner solutions panel, or a partner_solutions webhook's solution_id.

inputs.name: reject_deactivation_request
inputs.about: Set to true to reject the pending deactivation request and keep the solution active.

tools.name: Remove Assigned User from WhatsApp Business Account
tools.description: Remove an assigned user's access from the WhatsApp Business Account bound to the connection. The user must be reassigned to regain access.

inputs.name: user
inputs.about: The user ID of the person to remove from the WhatsApp Business Account. This must be a valid Facebook user ID that is currently assigned to the account.

inputs.name: waba_id
inputs.about: Optional: WhatsApp Business Account ID to target. If not provided, uses the waba_id from your connection configuration.

tools.name: Remove group participants
tools.description: Request removal of one to eight WhatsApp group participants. Removed participants cannot rejoin via an invite link. Requires a Groups API-eligible business number and its whatsapp_business_messaging permission. HTTP 200 means the request was processed, not that every removal succeeded. Inspect any returned errors and group_participants_update webhooks for final per-participant outcomes; this action does not wait for webhooks.

inputs.name: group_id
inputs.about: Group ID from group creation webhooks or the active groups listing.

inputs.name: participants
inputs.about: One to eight phone numbers or WhatsApp user IDs to remove, each supplied as a user object.

inputs.name: messaging_product
inputs.about: Messaging product; must be whatsapp.

tools.name: Request preverified number code
tools.description: Request a verification code for a business-owned pre-verified phone number. Delivers a code using IVR, SMS, or VOICE during pre-verified number onboarding. Use the pre-verified phone number node ID, not an ordinary phone number ID. Submit the received code separately with WHATSAPP_VERIFY_PREVERIFIED_NUMBER_CODE. This action requests delivery; it does not complete verification.

inputs.name: language
inputs.about: Verification message locale, such as en_US or en-US; extended locale codes are also supported. Unsupported languages fall back to en_US.

inputs.name: user_agent
inputs.about: Optional User-Agent header identifying the client software.

inputs.name: code_method
inputs.about: Delivery method for the verification code: IVR, SMS, or VOICE.

inputs.name: pre_verified_phone_number_id
inputs.about: Pre-verified phone number node ID provided during pre-verification; find it in WhatsApp Business Account settings. This is not an ordinary WhatsApp Business phone number ID or a telephone number.

tools.name: Request solution deactivation
tools.description: Ask the partner to deactivate an owned WhatsApp Multi-Partner Solution. The operation reference allows ACTIVE or INITIATED solutions; the guide describes owner-created ACTIVE solutions. Meta validates eligibility. Processing is asynchronous: the solution enters PENDING_DEACTIVATION and the partner is notified. It can still onboard clients until the partner accepts. Rejection leaves it ACTIVE; acceptance sets DEACTIVATED and stops client onboarding. Deactivated solutions cannot be edited. This submits the request only and does not accept the request or confirm final deactivation.

inputs.name: reason
inputs.about: Optional reason for requesting deactivation (at most 500 characters).

inputs.name: solution_id
inputs.about: Multi-Partner Solution ID from creation, the partner_solutions webhook, or App Dashboard > WhatsApp > Partner solutions. You must be the solution owner.

tools.name: Request verification code
tools.description: Request an SMS or voice verification code for a WhatsApp Business phone number. Sends a code to the phone number as the first step of phone number verification. Submit the received code separately with WHATSAPP_VERIFY_CODE. This action does not verify the code or register the phone number for Cloud API messaging.

inputs.name: language
inputs.about: Language locale for the verification message, for example 'en_US'.

inputs.name: user_agent
inputs.about: Optional User-Agent header identifying the client software.

inputs.name: code_method
inputs.about: Method for delivering the verification code: SMS or VOICE.

inputs.name: phone_number_id
inputs.about: WhatsApp Business phone number ID. Discover it with WHATSAPP_GET_PHONE_NUMBERS; this is not the phone number itself.

tools.name: Send contacts
tools.description: Send contacts WhatsApp number. Note: The message will be delivered to the recipient only if they have initiated a conversation first.

inputs.name: contacts
inputs.about: List of contacts to send. Each contact requires a name object with formatted_name, first_name, and last_name. Optional fields: addresses, birthday (YYYY-MM-DD), emails, org (company/department/title), and phones.

inputs.name: to_number
inputs.about: The phone number to send the contacts to, including the country code without the + sign.

inputs.name: recipient_type
inputs.about: The type of recipient. 'individual' (default) targets a phone number; 'group' targets a WhatsApp group id supplied in `to_number`.

inputs.name: phone_number_id
inputs.about: The phone number ID from which to send the contacts.

inputs.name: reply_to_message_id
inputs.about: Optional WhatsApp message ID (wamid...) of the message to reply to. When provided, this contact card is sent as a quoted reply (context.message_id) in the conversation thread.

tools.name: Send encrypted message
tools.description: Send a caller-encrypted WhatsApp message and return the encrypted response. Requires a registered business phone number with payload encryption enabled via POST /<Phone-Number-ID>/settings, and caller-side encryption/decryption with externally managed keys. Supply a pre-encrypted JWE containing the original /messages payload. Sending is irreversible. This action neither performs local cryptography nor decrypts the response or confirms delivery. Successful responses are encrypted; provider errors can be unencrypted.

inputs.name: phone_number_id
inputs.about: Registered sender WhatsApp Business phone number ID, discovered with WHATSAPP_GET_PHONE_NUMBERS. Payload encryption must already be enabled through POST /<Phone-Number-ID>/settings.

inputs.name: messaging_product
inputs.about: Messaging product; always whatsapp.

inputs.name: encrypted_contents
inputs.about: Pre-encrypted JWE string containing a payload with the original /messages structure. The caller must encrypt using provider-supported algorithms and manage keys externally. Forwarded exactly as supplied; no local encryption or JWE validation is performed.

tools.name: Send interactive buttons
tools.description: Send an interactive button message with up to 3 reply buttons to a WhatsApp user. Interactive button messages allow recipients to quickly respond by tapping predefined buttons. Perfect for yes/no questions, multiple choice selections, quick actions, or call-to-action scenarios. IMPORTANT REQUIREMENTS: - The recipient must be a registered WhatsApp user - The recipient must have messaged your business first within the last 24 hours (WhatsApp's customer service window) - You can include 1-3 buttons per message - Each button can have a title (max 20 chars) and unique ID (max 256 chars) Use cases: Customer service menus, appointment confirmations, feedback collection, product selections.

inputs.name: buttons
inputs.about: List of 1-3 interactive buttons. Each button must have a unique ID and title.

inputs.name: body_text
inputs.about: Main message text explaining the purpose or question for the buttons (maximum 1024 characters).

inputs.name: to_number
inputs.about: Recipient's phone number in international format without the + sign (e.g., '14155552345' for a US number). The recipient must be a registered WhatsApp user and must have messaged your business within the last 24 hours.

inputs.name: footer_text
inputs.about: Optional footer text displayed at the bottom of the message, below the buttons (maximum 60 characters).

inputs.name: header_text
inputs.about: Optional header text displayed at the top of the message (maximum 60 characters).

inputs.name: phone_number_id
inputs.about: The WhatsApp Business phone number ID from which to send the message. Get this from the WHATSAPP_GET_PHONE_NUMBERS action.

inputs.name: reply_to_message_id
inputs.about: Optional message ID to reply to. Use this to create a threaded conversation by replying to a specific previous message.

tools.name: Send interactive list
tools.description: Send an interactive list message to a WhatsApp number. List messages display a menu of options organized into sections. Users tap a button to view the list and select one option. Perfect for product catalogs, service menus, or guided workflows. Supports up to 10 sections with up to 10 items per section (100 total options). Note: Recipients must have messaged you first within the last 24 hours to receive this message.

inputs.name: sections
inputs.about: Sections containing list items (maximum 10 sections, minimum 1 section).

inputs.name: body_text
inputs.about: Body text for the list message (up to 1024 characters).

inputs.name: to_number
inputs.about: The recipient's phone number in international format without the + sign (e.g., '15551234567' for a US number). Note: The recipient must have initiated a conversation with your WhatsApp Business account within the last 24 hours to receive this message.

inputs.name: button_text
inputs.about: Text for the list button (up to 20 characters).

inputs.name: footer_text
inputs.about: Footer text for the list message (up to 60 characters).

inputs.name: header_text
inputs.about: Header text for the list message (up to 60 characters).

inputs.name: phone_number_id
inputs.about: The Meta-assigned numeric ID for the WhatsApp Business phone number to send from. This is NOT the actual phone number itself - it is a numeric ID (e.g., '901139066420489') assigned by Meta. Obtain it using WHATSAPP_GET_PHONE_NUMBERS action which returns the 'id' field for each phone number.

inputs.name: reply_to_message_id
inputs.about: The ID of the message to reply to (optional).

tools.name: Send location
tools.description: Send a location message with coordinates, name, and address to a WhatsApp user. This action allows you to share location information through WhatsApp Business API. The location message includes latitude/longitude coordinates, a location name, and address. Important: The recipient must have an active WhatsApp account. Additionally, you can only send free-form messages (like location messages) within the 24-hour customer service window after the recipient has initiated contact with your business. Outside this window, you must use approved message templates. Common error codes: - 133010: Recipient's phone number doesn't have a WhatsApp account - 131026: Message undeliverable (recipient may have blocked your business number) - 131047: Re-engagement message (outside 24-hour window, need to use template)

inputs.name: name
inputs.about: The name or title of the location (e.g., 'San Francisco City Hall', 'Golden Gate Bridge'). This will be displayed to the recipient.

inputs.name: address
inputs.about: The full address of the location (e.g., '1 Dr Carlton B Goodlett Pl, San Francisco, CA 94102'). This provides context to the recipient about the location.

inputs.name: latitude
inputs.about: The latitude coordinate of the location in decimal degrees format (e.g., '37.7749' for San Francisco). Range: -90 to 90.

inputs.name: longitude
inputs.about: The longitude coordinate of the location in decimal degrees format (e.g., '-122.4194' for San Francisco). Range: -180 to 180.

inputs.name: to_number
inputs.about: The recipient's WhatsApp phone number in international format without the + sign or spaces (e.g., '14155238886' for US number). The recipient must have a WhatsApp account registered with this number.

inputs.name: phone_number_id
inputs.about: The WhatsApp Business phone number ID from which to send the location message. This is the ID of your WhatsApp Business phone number, not the phone number itself.

inputs.name: reply_to_message_id
inputs.about: Optional WhatsApp message ID (wamid...) of the message to reply to. When provided, this location is sent as a quoted reply (context.message_id) in the conversation thread.

tools.name: Send marketing message
tools.description: Send an approved marketing template through the Marketing Messages API. Requires MM onboarding, a registered business phone number and an approved marketing template. Cloud API fallback depends on product_policy and account settings. Accepts phone numbers or BSUIDs; acceptance does not imply delivery.

inputs.name: to
inputs.about: Recipient WhatsApp phone number. Supply to or recipient; when both are supplied, to takes precedence.

inputs.name: type
inputs.about: Only template messages are supported by this endpoint.

inputs.name: bid_spec
inputs.about: Optional beta send-time max-price adjustment.

inputs.name: template
inputs.about: Approved marketing template and its variable parameters.

inputs.name: recipient
inputs.about: Recipient BSUID or parent BSUID obtained from WhatsApp webhooks. Used only when to is omitted. BSUID sends disable delivery optimization and cannot use dynamic-pricing templates.

inputs.name: product_policy
inputs.about: CLOUD_API_FALLBACK allows Cloud API routing if MM onboarding is incomplete (provider default). STRICT disables fallback.

inputs.name: recipient_type
inputs.about: Marketing message recipient type; must be individual.

inputs.name: phone_number_id
inputs.about: Registered sender business phone number ID, discovered with WHATSAPP_GET_PHONE_NUMBERS.

inputs.name: messaging_product
inputs.about: Messaging product; must be whatsapp.

inputs.name: message_activity_sharing
inputs.about: Enable or disable sharing this message's activity with Meta. Omit to use the account setting.

tools.name: Send media
tools.description: Send a media message to a WhatsApp number using a media URL. The recipient must have texted first to receive the media.

inputs.name: link
inputs.about: The publicly accessible HTTPS URL of the media file to send. The URL must be accessible by WhatsApp servers and serve the appropriate content-type header. For media uploads, use WHATSAPP_UPLOAD_MEDIA action to get a media ID and use WHATSAPP_SEND_MEDIA_BY_ID instead.

inputs.name: caption
inputs.about: Optional caption text to accompany the media (max 1024 characters). Only supported for 'image', 'video', and 'document' media types. Captions are NOT supported for 'audio' and 'sticker' types.

inputs.name: to_number
inputs.about: The phone number to send the media to, including the country code without the + sign.

inputs.name: media_type
inputs.about: The type of media to send. Options: 'audio' (voice messages), 'document' (PDFs, docs), 'image' (PNG, JPG), 'sticker' (WebP animated stickers), 'video' (MP4 videos). Note: Only 'image', 'video', and 'document' types support captions.

inputs.name: phone_number_id
inputs.about: The Meta-assigned numeric ID for the WhatsApp Business phone number to send from. This is NOT the actual phone number itself - it is a numeric ID (e.g., '901139066420489') assigned by Meta. Obtain it using WHATSAPP_GET_PHONE_NUMBERS action which returns the 'id' field for each phone number.

inputs.name: reply_to_message_id
inputs.about: Optional WhatsApp message ID (wamid...) of the message to reply to. When provided, this media message is sent as a quoted reply (context.message_id) in the conversation thread.

tools.name: Send media by
tools.description: Send media using a media ID from previously uploaded media. This is more efficient than sending media by URL as the media is already on WhatsApp servers. Use upload_media action first to get the media ID. Note: The media will be delivered to the recipient only if they have texted first.

inputs.name: caption
inputs.about: Caption for the media (not supported for audio and sticker).

inputs.name: filename
inputs.about: Filename for document media.

inputs.name: media_id
inputs.about: The media ID from uploaded media (use upload_media action to get this ID).

inputs.name: to_number
inputs.about: The phone number to send the media to, including the country code without the + sign.

inputs.name: media_type
inputs.about: The type of media to send: audio, document, image, sticker, or video.

inputs.name: phone_number_id
inputs.about: The phone number ID from which to send the media.

inputs.name: reply_to_message_id
inputs.about: The ID of the message to reply to (optional).

tools.name: Send message
tools.description: Send a text message to a WhatsApp user. Important: The recipient phone number must be registered on WhatsApp and must have initiated a conversation with your business within the last 24 hours, OR you must use a template message (see WHATSAPP_SEND_TEMPLATE_MESSAGE) for the first message outside the 24-hour window. For test accounts, recipient numbers must be added to the test recipient list in Meta Business Suite before sending messages.

inputs.name: text
inputs.about: The text content of the message to send. Supports Unicode characters including emojis. Maximum length: 4096 characters.

inputs.name: to_number
inputs.about: The recipient's WhatsApp phone number in international format without the + sign (e.g., '14155551234' for a US number). The number must be registered on WhatsApp.

inputs.name: message_id
inputs.about: Optional: The WhatsApp message ID (wamid) to reply to. When provided, this message will be sent as a reply to the specified message, creating a quoted reply thread. Leave empty to send a regular message.

inputs.name: preview_url
inputs.about: Set to True to show a preview card for URLs in the message. When enabled, WhatsApp will fetch and display URL metadata (title, description, image) for the first URL in the message. Default: False.

inputs.name: phone_number_id
inputs.about: The Meta-assigned numeric ID for the WhatsApp Business phone number to send from. This is NOT the actual phone number itself - it is a numeric ID (e.g., '712594308615206') assigned by Meta. Obtain it using WHATSAPP_GET_PHONE_NUMBERS action which returns the 'id' field for each phone number.

tools.name: Send template message
tools.description: Send a template message to a WhatsApp number.

inputs.name: to_number
inputs.about: The phone number to send the template message to, including the country code without the + sign.

inputs.name: components
inputs.about: Template components with parameters to fill template variables. Use 'body' type with text parameters for simple variable substitution.

inputs.name: language_code
inputs.about: The language code for the template.

inputs.name: template_name
inputs.about: The name of the template to be sent.

inputs.name: phone_number_id
inputs.about: The phone number ID from which to send the template message.

inputs.name: reply_to_message_id
inputs.about: Optional WhatsApp message ID (wamid...) of the message to reply to. When provided, this template message is sent as a quoted reply (context.message_id) in the conversation thread.

tools.name: Set business encryption
tools.description: Set the RSA public key used to encrypt WhatsApp message payloads and data channel requests. Upload a PEM public key for a WhatsApp Business phone number. Only one public key is active per phone number; uploading a new key replaces the previous key. Keep the corresponding private key outside this action.

inputs.name: phone_number_id
inputs.about: WhatsApp Business phone number ID. Discover it with WHATSAPP_GET_PHONE_NUMBERS.

inputs.name: business_public_key
inputs.about: RSA public key in PEM format to upload and sign for payload encryption. Supply only the public key, never a private key. Replaces the phone number's previous public key.

tools.name: Set obo mobility intent
tools.description: Set OBO mobility intent for a Multi-Partner Solution associated with a client WABA. For authorized solution providers/partners managing client accounts. Establishes On-Behalf-Of relationships and configures provider access and messaging mobility; settings may take a few minutes to propagate. The legacy OBO account ownership model is retired and replaced by partner-initiated account creation, but this operation remains in the official v23 spec. Confirm account eligibility with Meta; its presence in the spec does not guarantee availability for new OBO onboarding. Returns the provider's success flag, intent ID and any failure explanation.

inputs.name: body
inputs.about: OBO mobility intent configuration, including the required body waba_id.

inputs.name: waba_id
inputs.about: Path WhatsApp Business Account ID; find in Business Manager or owned/shared WABA listings. Requires solution-provider access to the client WABA.

tools.name: Set solution migration intent
tools.description: Set migration intent for a Multi-Partner Solution associated with a WABA. Requires an authorized solution partner with access to the WABA and eligible source/target solutions. Initiate, schedule, confirm, or cancel migration; Meta validates eligibility and pending state. This can change partner arrangements, trigger partner notifications, and execute migration at the scheduled time or immediately upon confirmation. A successful response records the intent, not proof that migration completed.

inputs.name: body
inputs.about: Migration intent JSON body for the solution associated with this WABA.

inputs.name: waba_id
inputs.about: WhatsApp Business Account ID from owned/shared WABA listings or WhatsApp Business Manager. Requires authorized solution-partner access.

tools.name: Set WhatsApp Two-Step Verification PIN
tools.description: Set or reset the two-step verification PIN for a WhatsApp Business phone number. Use when you need to change the 6-digit PIN that protects a registered phone number — for example after onboarding a new number, rotating credentials, or before re-registering. The initial PIN is set via register_phone; this action updates the PIN on an already-registered phone number. Endpoint: `POST /{phone-number-id}` with body `{"pin": "XXXXXX"}`. Meta's two-step-verification reference page is SPA-rendered, so the operation is documented as a property update on the phone-number node itself rather than a dedicated sub-path.

inputs.name: pin
inputs.about: New 6-digit two-step verification PIN. Must be exactly 6 digits.

inputs.name: phone_number_id
inputs.about: The ID of the phone number whose two-step verification PIN should be set or reset.

tools.name: Share preverified numbers
tools.description: Share a number from a business's pre-verified phone number pool with a partner. Requires ownership or sharing rights to the pre-verified number and a valid partner business accessible to the requesting app. The number retains its original ownership. Business relationship and access-control policies must allow the share; this action does not assign business roles or verify a number.

inputs.name: business_id
inputs.about: Business portfolio ID that owns or has sharing rights to the pre-verified number. Find it in Meta Business Manager or business management APIs.

inputs.name: preverified_id
inputs.about: Pre-verified phone number ID to share from the business's pool. Discover it with WHATSAPP_LIST_PREVERIFIED_NUMBERS; the requesting business must own it or have sharing rights.

inputs.name: partner_business_id
inputs.about: Partner business portfolio ID receiving access. Obtain it from the partner's Meta Business Manager; it must identify a valid business accessible to the requesting app.

tools.name: Subscribe to WABA Webhooks
tools.description: Subscribe your application to webhook notifications for the WhatsApp Business Account configured on the connection, using the configured app webhook settings.

inputs.name: waba_id
inputs.about: WhatsApp Business Account ID to subscribe to. If not provided, uses the WABA ID from auth headers.

inputs.name: verify_token
inputs.about: Verification token for webhook security. This token will be used to verify webhook callbacks.

inputs.name: override_callback_uri
inputs.about: Custom webhook callback URL to override app default. Must be a valid HTTPS URL.

tools.name: Unblock WhatsApp Users
tools.description: Unblock WhatsApp users so they can contact the business phone number again. Sends a DELETE with a JSON body. Inspect removed_users, failed_users and error: a successful HTTP response can contain partial or complete per-user failures.

inputs.name: block_users
inputs.about: Users to unblock, at most 1,000 per request. The DELETE reference marks this body field optional; supply users to perform an unblock.

inputs.name: phone_number_id
inputs.about: Meta-assigned business phone number ID, not its display phone number. Discover with WHATSAPP_GET_PHONE_NUMBERS.

inputs.name: messaging_product
inputs.about: Messaging product; use 'whatsapp'. Optional in the endpoint reference.

tools.name: Unsubscribe from WABA Webhooks
tools.description: Unsubscribe your application from webhook events for the connection-bound WhatsApp Business Account, for example when cleaning up an integration. If an account ID is supplied, it must match the connection. A success result does not always confirm that the subscription was removed.

inputs.name: waba_id
inputs.about: WhatsApp Business Account ID to unsubscribe from. If not provided, uses the WABA ID from auth headers.

tools.name: Update WhatsApp Flow Metadata
tools.description: Update metadata for a WhatsApp Flow including its name, categories, and endpoint URI. Use when you need to modify the configuration or settings of an existing WhatsApp Flow.

inputs.name: name
inputs.about: The new name for the Flow.

inputs.name: flow_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the Flow to update. Get this from the WHATSAPP_LIST_FLOWS action which returns the 'id' field for each flow.

inputs.name: categories
inputs.about: List of categories to assign to the Flow (e.g., ['OTHER', 'SIGN_UP']).

inputs.name: endpoint_uri
inputs.about: The endpoint URI where the Flow will send data.

tools.name: Update business account settings
tools.description: Update a WhatsApp Business Account's name or timezone identifier. Supply the WABA ID from WhatsApp Manager or the business management APIs. Omitted settings are left unchanged. This operation updates account settings, not WhatsApp Flow metadata.

inputs.name: name
inputs.about: Updated name for the WhatsApp Business Account.

inputs.name: waba_id
inputs.about: WhatsApp Business Account ID. Find it in WhatsApp Manager or through the business management APIs; this is not a Flow ID or phone number ID.

inputs.name: timezone_id
inputs.about: Updated timezone identifier for the WhatsApp Business Account.

tools.name: Update business compliance info
tools.description: Create or update regulatory compliance information for a WhatsApp Business phone number. Supply legal entity details and grievance officer and customer care contacts. Discover the phone number ID with WHATSAPP_GET_PHONE_NUMBERS.

inputs.name: entity_name
inputs.about: Legal business entity name (2–128 characters).

inputs.name: entity_type
inputs.about: Legal business entity type.

inputs.name: is_registered
inputs.about: Whether officially registered; allowed only for OTHER or PARTNERSHIP.

inputs.name: phone_number_id
inputs.about: WhatsApp Business phone number ID, not the phone number itself. Discover with WHATSAPP_GET_PHONE_NUMBERS or Business Manager.

inputs.name: messaging_product
inputs.about: Messaging product identifier; must be whatsapp.

inputs.name: entity_type_custom
inputs.about: Custom entity type; required for OTHER and forbidden for other entity types.

inputs.name: customer_care_details
inputs.about: Customer care contact details; email is required.

inputs.name: grievance_officer_details
inputs.about: Grievance officer contact details; name and email are required.

tools.name: Update WhatsApp Business Profile
tools.description: Update WhatsApp Business Profile information including business details, contact information, and profile settings. Use when you need to modify the business profile settings such as the about text, business category, address, description, email, and website URLs associated with a WhatsApp Business phone number. Note: Only fields that are provided will be updated. To clear an optional field, pass an empty string for text fields or an empty array for websites.

inputs.name: about
inputs.about: The text to display in the business profile's About section. Maximum 139 characters.

inputs.name: email
inputs.about: The contact email address of the business. Maximum 128 characters.

inputs.name: address
inputs.about: The address of the business. Maximum 256 characters.

inputs.name: vertical
inputs.about: The industry/vertical type of the WhatsApp Business account.

inputs.name: websites
inputs.about: List of URLs associated with the business. Maximum 2 URLs allowed.

inputs.name: description
inputs.about: Description of the business. Maximum 256 characters.

inputs.name: phone_number_id
inputs.about: The Meta-assigned numeric ID for the WhatsApp Business phone number. This is NOT the actual phone number - it is a numeric ID (e.g., '712594308615206') assigned by Meta. Obtain it using WHATSAPP_GET_PHONE_NUMBERS action which returns the 'id' field for each phone number.

inputs.name: messaging_product
inputs.about: The messaging service used for the request. Must be set to 'whatsapp'.

inputs.name: profile_picture_handle
inputs.about: The handle of the profile picture generated from the Resumable Upload API.

tools.name: Update business profile node
tools.description: Update a WhatsApp Business Profile directly by its profile node ID. Sends POST /{profile-id} with business details, contact information, industry vertical, websites, or a previously uploaded profile picture handle. Distinct from WHATSAPP_UPDATE_BUSINESS_PROFILE, which updates the /{phone-number-id}/whatsapp_business_profile edge. Returns the provider's optional profile ID and success flag without synthesizing success.

inputs.name: about
inputs.about: Business profile about text.

inputs.name: email
inputs.about: Business contact email address.

inputs.name: address
inputs.about: Physical business address.

inputs.name: vertical
inputs.about: Business industry vertical classification.

inputs.name: websites
inputs.about: Website URLs associated with the business.

inputs.name: description
inputs.about: Business description text.

inputs.name: messaging_product
inputs.about: Messaging service used for the request; must be whatsapp.

inputs.name: profile_picture_handle
inputs.about: Profile picture handle obtained through the Resumable Upload API.

inputs.name: whatsapp_business_profile_id
inputs.about: WhatsApp Business Profile node ID, found in WhatsApp Business Manager or through business management APIs. Supply the profile ID, not a phone number ID.

tools.name: Update WhatsApp commerce settings
tools.description: Set or update commerce settings for a WhatsApp Business phone number. Use this action to enable or disable shopping cart functionality and product catalog visibility for a specific WhatsApp Business phone number. The settings control whether customers can browse products and make purchases directly within WhatsApp. Note: At least one setting (is_cart_enabled or is_catalog_visible) should be provided in the request for meaningful updates.

inputs.name: is_cart_enabled
inputs.about: Enable or disable the shopping cart feature. When enabled, customers can add items to a cart and checkout directly in WhatsApp.

inputs.name: phone_number_id
inputs.about: The Meta-assigned numeric ID for the WhatsApp Business phone number (e.g., '712594308615206'). This is NOT the actual phone number - it is a numeric ID assigned by Meta. Obtain it using WHATSAPP_GET_PHONE_NUMBERS action which returns the 'id' field for each phone number.

inputs.name: is_catalog_visible
inputs.about: Make the product catalog visible to customers. When enabled, customers can browse your products directly in WhatsApp.

tools.name: Update Flow JSON
tools.description: Update the Flow JSON configuration for an existing WhatsApp Flow by uploading a file or inline JSON. The response may include validation errors; JSON error responses can also be returned without raising an HTTP error.

inputs.name: flow_id
inputs.about: The unique identifier of the flow. This is the ID assigned by Meta when the flow is created.

inputs.name: asset_type
inputs.about: The asset type being uploaded. Must be 'FLOW_JSON' for Flow JSON updates.

inputs.name: rawContent
inputs.about: Inline JSON content to upload as a string. Provide either file_to_upload or raw_content.

inputs.name: file_to_upload
inputs.about: The flow.json file to upload. The file name should be 'flow.json'.

tools.name: Update group
tools.description: Update an existing WhatsApp group's subject, description, or photo. Requires an eligible Official Business Account using Cloud API. Omitted settings are not sent. Supplying file uploads the photo using multipart form data; otherwise settings are sent as JSON. HTTP acceptance does not establish that every setting changed: inspect group_settings_update webhooks for success, partial failure, or total failure.

inputs.name: file
inputs.about: Group profile picture to upload as multipart file data. Must be JPEG, maximum 5 MB, square, and at least 192 by 192 pixels. Omit to send a JSON-only settings update.

inputs.name: subject
inputs.about: New group subject, 1–128 characters. Omit to leave unchanged.

inputs.name: group_id
inputs.about: WhatsApp group ID. Obtain it from WHATSAPP_LIST_GROUPS or the group creation lifecycle webhook.

inputs.name: description
inputs.about: New group description, at most 2048 characters. Omit to leave unchanged.

inputs.name: messaging_product
inputs.about: Messaging product; must be whatsapp.

inputs.name: profile_picture_file
inputs.about: Provider-documented profile_picture_file path, forwarded unchanged as text. For an actual binary photo upload, use file instead; no path is inferred from the uploaded file.

tools.name: Update official business account status
tools.description: Submit OBA application information or update application data for a phone number. Sends business website, country, and optional notability information to the Official Business Account application/update endpoint. This does not directly set approval status. Although the reference mentions withdrawal and resubmission, it documents no intent selector; this action exposes only the documented payload. Meta enforces eligibility and application-state transitions.

inputs.name: phone_number_id
inputs.about: WhatsApp Business phone number ID, not the telephone number. Obtain the id from WHATSAPP_GET_PHONE_NUMBERS.

inputs.name: primary_language
inputs.about: Primary language used by the business.

inputs.name: supporting_links
inputs.about: Supporting URLs demonstrating business notability; provide 5 to 10 links when supplied.

inputs.name: business_website_url
inputs.about: Official business website URL.

inputs.name: parent_business_or_brand
inputs.about: Parent business or brand name.

inputs.name: primary_country_of_operation
inputs.about: Primary country where the business operates.

inputs.name: additional_supporting_information
inputs.about: Additional information supporting the OBA application.

tools.name: Update WhatsApp Cloud API Settings
tools.description: Update Cloud API settings for a WhatsApp Business phone number. Use this action to modify calling features, user identity verification settings, payload encryption configuration, and data storage preferences for a specific WhatsApp Business phone number. Note: Only one setting type can be updated per request (calling, user_identity_change, payload_encryption, or storage_configuration). The API uses a oneOf schema, so including multiple setting types will result in an error.

inputs.name: calling
inputs.about: Calling feature settings.

inputs.name: phone_number_id
inputs.about: The WhatsApp Business phone number ID (e.g., '712594308615206'). Get this from the WHATSAPP_GET_PHONE_NUMBERS action.

inputs.name: payload_encryption
inputs.about: Payload encryption settings.

inputs.name: user_identity_change
inputs.about: User identity change settings.

inputs.name: storage_configuration
inputs.about: Storage configuration settings.

tools.name: Upload file chunk
tools.description: Upload raw file bytes to a resumable upload session and return its file handle. Create the session first with WHATSAPP_CREATE_UPLOAD_SESSION. To resume, retrieve WHATSAPP_GET_UPLOAD_OFFSET and supply the remaining bytes with that offset. The connected account must provide the user access token required by the Resumable Upload API.

inputs.name: file
inputs.about: File containing the bytes to upload. For a resumed upload, supply only the remaining bytes starting at file_offset; this action does not slice the file.

inputs.name: file_offset
inputs.about: Byte offset in the upload session: 0 for a new upload, or the file_offset returned by WHATSAPP_GET_UPLOAD_OFFSET when resuming.

inputs.name: upload_session_id
inputs.about: Session ID returned by WHATSAPP_CREATE_UPLOAD_SESSION. Pass the returned id, including upload: and any ?sig= signature, unchanged; a bare session ID is also accepted.

tools.name: Upload media
tools.description: Upload media files (images, videos, audio, documents, stickers) to WhatsApp servers. The uploaded media gets a media ID that can be used in send_media or other messaging actions. Supported formats: - Images: JPEG, PNG (max 5MB) - Videos: MP4, 3GPP (max 16MB) - Audio: AAC, M4A, AMR, MP3, OGG (max 16MB) - Documents: PDF, DOC, DOCX, PPT, PPTX, XLS, XLSX (max 100MB) - Stickers: WebP (max 500KB, 512x512 pixels)

inputs.name: media_type
inputs.about: Type of media being uploaded: image, video, audio, document, or sticker.

inputs.name: file_to_upload
inputs.about: Media file to upload to WhatsApp (max 16MB for most types, 100MB for videos).

inputs.name: phone_number_id
inputs.about: The phone number ID to upload media for.

tools.name: Upsert message template
tools.description: Create or update a message template for the WhatsApp Business Account. Use this action when you need to create a new message template or update an existing one with the same name. If a template with the same name and language exists, it will be updated. Otherwise, a new template will be created. Templates must be approved by WhatsApp before they can be used. Templates are required for marketing messages and messages sent outside the 24-hour window.

inputs.name: name
inputs.about: Unique template name. Must be lowercase, alphanumeric with underscores only. Maximum 512 characters. Example: 'order_confirmation_v1'.

inputs.name: waba_id
inputs.about: WhatsApp Business Account ID. If not provided, uses the waba_id from your connection configuration.

inputs.name: category
inputs.about: Template category. AUTHENTICATION: for OTP/verification codes. MARKETING: for promotional content (requires opt-in). UTILITY: for transactional updates like order status, appointments.

inputs.name: language
inputs.about: Template language code in ISO 639-1 format with country code. Examples: 'en_US' (US English), 'es_ES' (Spanish), 'pt_BR' (Brazilian Portuguese).

inputs.name: components
inputs.about: List of template components. Must include at least one BODY component. Can optionally include one HEADER, one FOOTER, and one BUTTONS component.

tools.name: Verify Phone Number OTP Code
tools.description: Verify the OTP code for a pre-verified phone number. Use when you need to complete phone number verification by submitting the received OTP code. The phone number must first be added to your WhatsApp Business Account and a verification code must have been requested through the setup process. This action completes the verification by submitting the 6-digit code received via SMS or voice call. Note: This action verifies a phone number that has been pre-verified and is awaiting OTP confirmation.

inputs.name: code
inputs.about: 6-digit verification code received via SMS or voice call. The code must be exactly 6 digits.

inputs.name: phone_number_id
inputs.about: The ID of the phone number to verify. This ID is provided when the phone number is added to your WhatsApp Business Account.

tools.name: Verify preverified number code
tools.description: Verify an OTP for a pre-verified phone number to complete verification. First request a code with WHATSAPP_REQUEST_PREVERIFIED_NUMBER_CODE, then submit the received code with the same pre-verified phone number node ID. This updates the number's verification status. Expired, invalid, or reused codes fail.

inputs.name: code
inputs.about: Numeric verification code received via SMS or voice after requesting a code with WHATSAPP_REQUEST_PREVERIFIED_NUMBER_CODE. Codes expire and can only be used once.

inputs.name: user_agent
inputs.about: Optional User-Agent header identifying the client software.

inputs.name: pre_verified_phone_number_id
inputs.about: Pre-verified phone number node ID returned when creating the pre-verified number; find it in WhatsApp Business Manager or the pre-verified phone number listing. This is not a telephone number.

tools.name: Who Am I
tools.description: Return the identity (name) of the connected WhatsApp (Meta) account.
